strings.(에스닐의 이면에서 돌아온 %s의 이야기가 길어질수록 이리스의 표정이 조: (As %s recounts what happened in Esnil's Other Side, Iris's expression gradually grows tense.)
After seeing that future, I have to go...
strings.그런데, 이리스…. 실피드 님 같은 정령왕이 왜 글래스턴의 정보를 알 수: But Iris... Why couldn't a Spirit King like Sylphid learn anything about Glaston?
Someone is deliberately preventing information about what happens inside from getting out.
strings.예지에 나온 것처럼 강하고 불길한 힘을 가지고 있는 존재라면 충분히 가능: A being with the powerful, ominous presence in that vision could certainly do it...
If I were just a little stronger, I might have noticed sooner...
Iris, this must have started before you ever left Belos. None of it is your fault.
strings.미안해요. 자꾸 약한 소리를 해서…. 전 반복되는 상황을 끊고 싶은 건데: I'm sorry. I keep sounding so helpless... I want to put an end to this cycle...
strings.누군가가 잘못된 믿음을 신념으로 삼았던 그 순간부터 많은 생명이 고통받았: The moment someone turns a misguided belief into an unshakable conviction, countless lives suffer.
strings.키마이라 연구소의 일로 아틀란티스가 바다 밑으로 가라앉았고, 반과 마라가: The Chimera Laboratory's work sank Atlantis beneath the sea. Ban and Mara killed so many living beings to create magic stones.
Weiss tried to destroy Etoile simply to save his own world.
And now there are mages trying to create a new god for a world they believe has none.
Not every god is like Seres or Gaia.
strings.(이리스가 입술을 지그시 깨무는 %s의 두 손을 붙잡는다.): (Iris takes both hands of %s, who is biting their lip.)
strings.카이나 황제께서도 위대한 벽의 틈을 보고 계시다는 걸 알았을 때, 설마…: When I learned Empress Kaina could see the gaps in the Great Wall, I suspected... But I hoped I was wrong.
strings.세상엔 생각지도 못한 상황을 운명으로 받아들여야 하는 사람들이 종종 있어: Some people must accept a fate they could never have imagined.
strings.폐하께선 더는 버틸 수 없어서 동생과 %s에게 말씀하셨을지도 몰라요. 도: Perhaps Her Majesty could no longer bear it alone, and told her sister and you, %s, to ask for help...
strings.이제 글래스턴에 가야겠지. 그동안 폐하의 예지 내용이 한 번도 틀린 적이: Then I have to go to Glaston. Her Majesty's visions have never been wrong. That frightens me a little.
strings.말씀드리지 못한 게 있는데, 그동안 폐하가 본 미래는 모두 부정적인 것들: There's something I haven't told you. Many of the futures Her Majesty saw were grim. But little by little, they've changed for the better.
strings.정확하진 않지만, %s의 활약으로 위대한 벽이 조금씩 안정되고 있는 것: I can't be certain, but your efforts seem to be gradually stabilizing the Great Wall, %s.
I couldn't trust feelings like that before. But now I can.
I'll do whatever I can to change the future Her Majesty and I saw.
This will be more dangerous than anything before.
Don't worry. You're always behind me, Iris. It'll be all right.
Thank you, %s... Oh, wait a moment.
There's something I want to show you. Someone's memory, carried through a gap in the Great Wall...
strings.누군지는 잘 모르겠지만, 확실한 건 있어요. 이 기억의 장소는 바로 글래: I don't know whose it is. But I know one thing: it takes place in Glaston.
strings.%s의 이야기를 듣고 나서야 이해할 수 있게 됐어요. 닿지 않았던 글래스: I only understood after hearing your story, %s. Information from Glaston, which was beyond our reach, is now coming to us...
Something there is calling us to Glaston.
strings.일단 보고 판단할게. 그래도 괜찮지?: Let me see it first, then decide. Is that all right?
strings.어떻게 해야 그 기억을 볼 수 있는 거야?: How do I see this memory?
Close your eyes for a moment. I'll bring it into your mind.
strings.(눈을 감았을 때 찾아오는 옅은 어둠 사이로 빛이 비집고 들어온다. 그리: (Light slips through the soft darkness behind closed eyes. It unfolds someone else's memory, in a strange place never seen before.)
I have to get out. I have to...
strings.(말라버린 수로를 힘겹게 뛰어다니던 작은 소녀의 발걸음이 멈춘다. 불안했: (A little girl stops after struggling through a dry waterway. She nibbles anxiously at a fingernail.)
strings.(소녀가 결심한 듯 고개를 들어 앞을 바라보더니 들고 있던 우산을 활짝: (As though making up her mind, she raises her head and opens the umbrella in her hand.)
strings.(우산을 방패 삼아 앞으로 달려갈 준비를 하자 동물 귀같은 소녀의 귀가: (Her animal-like ears twitch as she braces to charge, using the umbrella as a shield.)
(On three, she rushes forward, only to hit something and bounce back.)
(The girl keeps running toward what appears to be the exit. Each attempt ends the same way.)
strings.(소녀를 가로막는 보이지 않는 벽은 전보다 더 세게 강하게 소녀를 안으로: (The invisible wall blocking her pushes her back inside with even greater force.)
strings.나가고 싶어. 나가고 싶단 말이야. 왜 나가지 못하게 하는 건데?: I want to leave. I want to get out! Why won't you let me?
strings.노네임이 나간 거면 나도 나갈 수 있잖아. 그런데 왜 나만 나가지 못하게: No Name got out, so I should be able to! Why am I the only one who can't leave? I want to go...
strings.나는, 아탈란테는 나갈 거야. 나가서 엄마 만나야 해. 엄마 보고 싶단: I'm going to leave. I, Atalante, am getting out! I have to see Mommy. I miss her!
(Sobbing, the girl keeps rushing toward the exit, only to end up where she began. Elsewhere in that ominous place, a mage arrives, searching for something.)
...Haah. I came as ordered, but there's no way it could be here—
strings.(그런 그때, 저 앞에서 튕겨나온 아탈란테의 모습이 보인다.): (Just then, he sees Atalante thrown backward ahead of him.)
strings.(마법사가 넘어져 있는 아탈란테를 발견하고는 뒤로 물러난다. 그러더니 왔: (Seeing Atalante on the ground, the mage backs away, then carefully walks back the way he came.)
strings.(아탈란테가 그런 마법사를 발견하고는 그에게 달려간다.): (Atalante spots the mage and runs toward him.)
Mister! You know me, don't you? It's me! Let me out!
strings.(겁에 질린 마법사가 미친듯이 뛰어가지만, 아탈란테에게 따라 잡힌다. 그: (The terrified mage runs desperately, but Atalante catches up. After several attempts to escape, he ends up cornered in a dead end.)
Mister Mage... Please, help me. You can get out, can't you? I have to leave. I have to see Mommy... Please...
Wh-why are you doing this to me...? I... I only did what I was told...
strings.(마법사의 말에 울상짓던 아탈란테의 움직임이 멈춘다. 그리고 흔들리던 눈: (At his words, the tearful Atalante goes still. Her trembling eyes stop moving and fix on him.)
strings.(투명한 아탈란테의 눈동자 가득 겁에 질린 마법사의 모습이 가득 채워지고: (The terrified mage's reflection fills Atalante's clear eyes...)
strings.(…다시 다가오는 어둠과 함께 그곳엔 비명 소리가 울려 퍼진다.): (...And as darkness returns, a scream echoes through the place.)
You can open your eyes now, %s.
strings.저 아이, 누굴까? 왜 저기 있는 걸까? 분명 아탈란테라고 했던 것 같은: Who is that child? Why is she there? I think she said her name was Atalante...
strings.하지만, 확실한 건…. 마법사가 아탈란테라는 소녀를 보고 뭐라 말한 것: But one thing is certain... The mage said something when he saw her, and I couldn't hear it.
strings.이리스도? 설마 신의 이름이라서 그런 거야?: You couldn't either? Could it have been a god's name?
Perhaps it was the name of someone I don't know.
strings.그 소녀가 거기 있는 이유는 아마도 마법청과 관련이 있을 것 같아요. 노: I think her presence there has something to do with the Magic Bureau. She knows No Name, too...
strings.전에 바이스가 데이모스를 부른 것처럼 열쇠 같은 존재를 따로 둔 건 아닐: Could they be keeping her as a key, like when Weiss summoned Deimos... ?
strings.일단 글래스턴에 가볼게. 이리스가 대비하려면 내가 먼저 알아보는 수밖에…: I'll go to Glaston. I need to investigate so you can prepare, Iris.
No. I've only heard the name.
strings.흠…. 그러면 이번에는 어떻게 가지? 어쩔 수 없지. 도와줄 사람을 찾아: Hmm... How will I get there this time? I'll have to find someone who can help.
Everything will be all right, Iris. Don't worry too much.
strings.(눈을 감은 채, 뭔가 생각하고 있던 데이나가 인기척을 느끼고 앞을 바라: (Dayna, deep in thought with her eyes closed, senses someone approaching and looks up.)
strings.%s 씨, …좀 쉬고 있으라니까 어딜 다녀온 거야?: %s... I told you to rest. Where have you been?
I thought Iris needed to know what was happening.
strings.지금 글래스턴에 가려고? 아직 때가 되지 않았는데…. 혹시 새로운 정보라: Are you heading to Glaston now? It isn't time yet... Have you learned something new?
strings.(잠시 머뭇거리고 있던 %s의 귓가에 이리스의 목소리가 들려온다.): (As %s hesitates, Iris's voice reaches their ear.)
Not in person. She said I could tell you what I saw.
strings.(데이나에게 이리스와 함께 이야기하며 본 것을 전한다. 글래스턴의 정보가: (I tell Dayna what Iris and I discussed and saw, from the barrier keeping Glaston's secrets from Iris and the spirits to the girl in the underground waterway.)
So that's why. Now I understand...
The Other Side is hard to find, but it's always existed beside people.
strings.성역 에이도스 같은 사람이 잘 찾지 않는 곳에도, 에스닐 같이 규모가 큰: It's present in places few people visit, like Eidos Sanctuary, and in large towns like Esnil...
But I've never found it in Glaston, the largest city on the continent.
If a being on Iris's level was blocking information, that would certainly explain it.
strings.그럴 수도 있겠군요. 흐음…. 아, 지하수로처럼 보이는 장소가 어딘지 아: That makes sense. Hmm... Do you know where that underground waterway might be?
Glaston's underground waterways are vast. I couldn't pinpoint the location.
strings.수 백년 전 왕국이 제국으로 변모하면서 도시 계획을 세웠는데, 그때 하수: When the kingdom became an empire centuries ago, they planned the city, including its drainage system. It's still being maintained today...
strings.손을 댈 수 없을 정도로 상태가 나쁜 수로는 그냥 내버려둔다고 했던 것: But I believe they abandon waterways that are too badly damaged to repair.
strings.글래스턴 출신이면 다들 아는 이야기라 좋은 정보라고 하기엔 애매해. 일단: Everyone from Glaston knows it, so I'm not sure I'd call it useful. The question is where to start looking...
strings.글래스턴이 보통 도시도 아니고, 기억 속의 그 장소를 찾으려면 한참 헤매: Glaston is no ordinary city. Finding the place in that memory could take a very long time.
Leave that to me. I'll go ahead and find a way.
strings.(데이나가 %s의 기세에 살짝 놀란 표정을 짓는다. 그러다 조용히 미소: (Dayna looks a little surprised by %s's resolve, then smiles quietly.)
strings.고마워, %s 씨. …그러고 보니 그동안 많이 변했네. 처음엔 뭔가 많이: Thank you, %s. ...You've changed a lot. When we first met, you seemed weighed down by so much...
It isn't time yet, but I have something in mind. I should get moving, too. It'll only be a few days, but I'm counting on you.
You don't know the way to Glaston, do you? Narsha does. Go with her.
strings.정기적으로 마법청에서 나르샤의 마도골렘을 확인하고 있는데, 마침 그 시기: The Magic Bureau regularly inspects Narsha's magic golem. Her next visit happens to be due now.
strings.나르샤를 가지 못하게 해서 괜한 의심을 살 필요는 없잖아. 마법청 마법사: Stopping her from going would only raise suspicion. As long as the Bureau's mages are studying the golem, they won't harm its owner.
Besides, Narsha has plenty of people behind her. They know that.
She'll be happy to have you along, %s. Go on.
And when you reach Glaston's central square, look for Silvia.
strings.아르젠트의 여동생. 아르젠트와 닮았으니까 금방 알아볼 수 있을 거야. 내: Argent's younger sister. She looks like him, so you'll recognize her. Tell her I sent you.
Thank you, Dayna. See you later.
And then the wicked fairy met the golem...
strings.(나르샤가 언젠가 찾았던 책을 읽고 있다. 얼마나 집중했는지 근처에 누가: (Narsha is reading the book she found some time ago. She is so absorbed that she seems unaware of anyone approaching.)
strings.곧 글래스턴에 간다면서요?: I hear you're going to Glaston soon.
strings.어떻게 아셨어요? 아, 총장님께 들으셨구나. 마도리 점검 받을 겸 마법청: How did you know? Oh, the President told you. I'm going to the Magic Bureau for Madori's inspection.
strings.저도 마침 글래스턴에 가야 하는데, 가는 길을 잘 몰라서요. 데이나 씨가: I need to go to Glaston, too, but I don't know the way. Dayna suggested I go with you.
strings.와아, 진짜요? 라클렛이나 젤릭이 이번에는 같이 가는 게 힘들다 그래서: Wow, really? Raclette and Jelic said they couldn't come this time. I wondered who would. And it's you!
I heard you were visiting the Magic Bureau...
strings.너무 걱정하지 마세요. 가도 크게 특별한 일을 하는 건 아니라 괜찮을 거: Don't worry. We don't do anything particularly unusual there. It'll be fine.
I just speak briefly with a mage, and he checks Madori's condition.
strings.제가 이것저것 말 시켜서 마도리가 그대로 하는지 보는 거예요. 팔 들어볼: I ask Madori to do things and see whether it follows along. Raise your arm. Roll forward. Jump a little. Dance.
strings.담당인 레이븐 마법사님 본인도 왜 이런걸 하는지 모르시겠대요. 아, 레이: Raven, the mage in charge, says even he doesn't know why we do it. Oh, he's the one who checks Madori.
strings.그렇군요. 흐음…. 아, 언제 갈 예정이에요?: I see. Hmm... When are you planning to leave?
As soon as I put this book away. Wait just a moment.
You didn't. Shall we go? I haven't seen that outfit in a while.
strings.왠지 이번엔 이 옷을 입고 가야 할 것 같아서요. 어때요? 이상해요?: I felt like I should wear it this time. What do you think? Does it look strange?
It suits you. You still like the outfit Minos gave you, don't you?
strings.마음에 들기도 한데다가 제가 더 강해진 것 같은 기분이 들어서요. 게다가: I do, and it makes me feel stronger. I like it even more because it was a gift from someone like me.
I'd love to visit Minos again...
Let's go together sometime. He'd be happy to see you.
Oh, when we go to Knossos... I hope we don't see that strange man.
Ahaha... All right. He makes me a little uncomfortable, too...
strings.헤에, 모험가님. 저하고 마음이 통했네요?: Hehe. We think alike, don't we?
strings.글래스턴으로 가려면 루리아 마을 근처에 있는 라란 가도에서 쭉 올라가면: To get to Glaston, we can head straight up the Laran Road near Luria Village.
strings.어, 거기에 길이 있었나?: Oh, was there a path there?
strings.어디로 가든 글래스턴으로만 가면 된다는 말 아시죠? 그만큼 글래스턴으로: You know the saying: whichever road you take, all that matters is reaching Glaston. There are that many ways to get there.
strings.그리고 레이븐 마법사님이 꼭 걸어서 오라고 했거든요. 정확한 데이터 측정: And Raven told me to make sure we walk. Something about getting accurate measurements... I've done it several times, but I still don't understand why.
strings.혹시 말인데, 오르카리움에서 돌아온 후에 마법청에 간 적 있어요?: Have you visited the Magic Bureau since returning from Orcarium?
strings.아뇨. 그런데 방문해달라는 요청은 한 번 있었어요. 총장님께서 의심스럽다: No. They did ask me to come once, but the President thought it was suspicious and declined for me.
She said, 'So this is another use for my authority as a princess.'
strings.라란 가도에 가면 일단 레온 아저씨부터 볼까요? 레온 아저씨가 가는 길에: Shall we see Mister Leon when we reach the Laran Road? He chases the Hefrings off the path for me.
strings.처지가 다르면서도 조금 비슷하다고 해야 할까요. 레온 아저씨는 완전 수인: Our situations are different, but a little alike. Leon is fully one of the beastfolk, and people sometimes call me beastfolk, too...
strings.글래스턴으로 가던 중에 몇 번 만나면서 친해졌어요. 진짜 재미있는 사람이: We became friends after meeting on my trips to Glaston. He's really funny.
He is. So funny he's a little strange... Ahaha...
strings.모험가님, 이제 갈까요? 제가 너무 늦장 부렸죠?: Shall we go? I've been dawdling, haven't I?
Oh! Narsa? Narsa, it's been ages! And hello, hello to %s, owner of the Chamber of the Great %s!
strings.(레온이 도시락을 노리는 헤프링을 쫓던 중, 다가오는 %s 일행을 알아보: (While chasing Hefrings away from his lunchbox, Leon notices %s and Narsha approaching and waves.)
Mister Leon, I've told you before. My name is Narsha, not Narsa.
Right, Naru-Naru. And don't call me Mister. I'm only twenty.
strings.나루나루 아니라고요, 나르샤…. 하아. 반쯤 포기하고 있었는데, 역시 포: Not Naru-Naru. Narsha... Haah. I'd half given up, but I suppose I should give up completely.
strings.레온은 여전하네요. 그런데 그 방 이름은 어떻게 아는 거죠?: Same old Leon. But how do you know the room's name?
strings.무슨 방? 위대한 %s의 방? 위대하다 못해 멋진 %s의 방?: What room? The Chamber of the Great %s? The Chamber of the Great and Magnificent %s?
Aagh, stop making such a fuss about that name!
strings.네레이스 관문 센터 숙소 이름이 특이하다고 들었는데, 어떻게 %s 님 이: I heard the lodgings at the Nereis Gateway Center had a peculiar name. How did yours end up on them, %s?
strings.헬레나 할머니에게 들었는데, 황제 폐하께서 %s 오면 언제든 쉬라고 그: Granny Helena told me. Her Majesty personally named the room so %s could rest there whenever they visited.
strings.나루롱도 그렇게 생각했어? 역시 우리 잘 통하네. 오늘도 글래스턴으로 가: You think so too, Narulong? We really do get along. Off to Glaston again today?
Yes. %s is coming with me today.
Lucky you. I've never been to Glaston.
strings.사실 글래스턴에 도착해도 제가 갈 수 있는 곳은 거의 없어요. 마법청사: Even when I get there, there are hardly any places I'm allowed to go. Just the Magic Bureau, really...
strings.나르샤, 미안해. 쟤는 내가 못 간 곳도 가보네, 하고 이런 바보 같은: I'm sorry, Narsha. I had a stupid thought: she gets to visit places I've never been.
strings.괜찮아요. 제가 레온이 못 가보는 마법청사도 가보는 건 사실이잖아요. 그: It's all right. I do get to visit the Magic Bureau, and you don't. So don't call yourself stupid. Unless you are a little stupid?
Thanks. I appreciate it, but... Now you really are calling me stupid.
It's nice seeing how close you two are.
strings.장난이야, 장난. 지금 내가 글래스턴 가는 길에 밥 달라고 달려드는 헤프: Kidding, kidding. I'll chase away the Hefrings that beg for food on the road to Glaston. Take good care of Narsha, all right?
strings.고마워요, 레온. 돌아올 때, 전에 먹고 싶다고 했던 초콜릿 사다 줄게요: Thanks, Leon. I'll bring you the chocolate you wanted on my way back.
strings.오, 정말? 기다리고 있을게, 나르샤! 잘 가, %s. 나는 이만, 헤프: Oh, really? I'll be waiting, Narsha! Goodbye, %s. Time to chase some Hefrings!
strings.(그 말과 함께 레온이 먹이를 찾아 달려드는 헤프링을 쫓는다.): (With that, Leon goes after the Hefrings rushing in for food.)
strings.모험가님. 글래스턴 가는 길은 저쪽이에요. 절 따라오세요. 어, 그런데: The road to Glaston is over there. Follow me. Wait... Is it all right for Leon to eat chocolate?
strings.(멀리서도 보일 정도로 하늘을 향해 높이 뻗어있는 성의 모습이 가까워진다: (The castle, towering high enough to be seen from afar, draws closer. But the street where they stop feels very different from that distant grandeur.)
strings.여기부터 글래스턴이에요. 저기, 저쪽에 있는 성 보이시죠? 저기가 폐하께: This is Glaston. See the castle over there? That's Her Majesty's imperial palace.
strings.황성 밑에 높은 건물들이 들어선 곳은 관청들이 있는 행정지구, 그 밑이: The tall buildings below it are the government offices in the administrative district. Below those is the central square.
strings.(나르샤가 설명을 하다 말고 고개를 푹 숙인다.): (Narsha trails off and bows her head.)
I know what you're trying to say. I'm all right. Don't worry about me.
strings.모험가님, 저는 이 앞에 있는 여관에 있을 거예요. 글래스턴에 오면 여기: I'll be at the inn just ahead. That's where I stay when I come to Glaston.
While I'm resting, Raven sends someone for me. I go with them, then come back. That's all.
strings.(나르샤 말대로 위험한 일은 아닌 것 같지만….): (As Narsha says, it doesn't sound dangerous, but...)
strings.너무 걱정하진 마세요. 글래스턴에도 총장님이나 젤릭, 라클렛 같은 분들이: Don't worry too much. There are people in Glaston like the President, Jelic, and Raclette. They can help me get home, too.
Those people? Oh, then it should be fine.
strings.나르샤, 그분들이 무슨 일을 하는지 알고 있었어요?: Narsha, you knew what they do?
Not the details. I just know they do something a little special.
What will you do now? You said you had business here.
I'll visit the person Dayna introduced me to.
strings.(나르샤가 %s에게 인사하고, 숙소로 보이는 건물을 향해 걸어간다.): (Narsha says goodbye to %s and heads toward what appears to be her lodgings.)
Narsha... You must have had so many questions...
(Only after Narsha leaves does %s take in the street around them.)
strings.(웅장한 성과 함께 깨끗한 분위기가 느껴지는 북쪽과는 달리 모험가가 서있: (Unlike the clean northern district and its magnificent castle, the street where the adventurer stands has a very different atmosphere.)
strings.(낡고 허름한 건물들과 제대로 정비 되지 않은 길, 그 앞으로 부서진 푯: (Old, shabby buildings. Poorly maintained roads. Broken signs, carts, and shattered bottles.)
strings.(거기에 건물과 건물 사이에 적당히 줄을 매어 널어놓은 빨랫감까지.): (Laundry hangs on makeshift lines strung between the buildings.)
strings.시골 마을 느낌이 나네…. 그래도 사람들이 많은 걸 보면 도시는 도신가: It feels like a country village... Though with this many people, it's clearly a city. Plenty of vendors, and children running everywhere.
strings.(그런 그때, 멀리서 기타를 들고 주위를 두리번 거리는 한 소녀의 모습이: (A girl carrying a guitar looks around in the distance.)
strings.(모험가가 다가가자 기타를 들고 있던 소녀가 환하게 웃으며 맞이한다.): (As the adventurer approaches, the girl with the guitar greets them with a bright smile.)
If you've brought a gift, the thought is enough. But a heartfelt letter is always welcome.
A gift? A letter? I just wanted to ask...
strings.아! 아하하하, 제 팬이 아니시구나. 당연히 제게 뭔가 주시려고 하는 줄: Oh! Ahahaha, you're not a fan. I assumed you'd come to give me something.
strings.안녕하세요, 저는 데이지에요! 편하게, 편하게 데이지라고 불러주세요!: Hello! I'm Daisy. Just call me Daisy. No need to be formal!
strings.그리고 팬이 아니라고 해도 괜찮답니다. 무엇이든지 물어보세요!: And it's fine if you're not a fan. Ask me anything!
strings.답변해드리는 거 좋아하거든요. 하지만! 짓궂은 질문 같은 거 하시면 기타: I love answering questions. But if you ask anything cheeky, I'll whack you with my guitar!
(The girl who introduced herself as Daisy lifts her guitar with a dazzling smile.)
strings.중앙 광장으로 가려면 어떻게 가야 하죠?: How do I get to the central square?
strings.절 궁금해하신 게 아니었군요. 그래도 괜찮아요. 중앙 광장은 제 뒤로 보: Oh, so you weren't curious about me. That's fine. To reach the square, follow the road behind me straight up. All the way up.
strings.앞으로 더 노력해야겠어요. 못 알아보시는 분들이 많은 걸 보면, 전 아직: I'll have to work harder. If this many people still don't recognize me, I have a long way to go.
Sorry, Daisy. Next time, I'll say hello first.
That's kind of you. Hehe. I'll keep trying.
strings.(커다란 빗자루를 들고 있는 건장한 체격의 청년이 고개를 끄덕이며 인사한: (A sturdy young man carrying a large broom nods in greeting.)
strings.처음 뵙겠습니다. 광장 관리부 소속의 관리원 모란이라고 합니다. 혹시 신: A pleasure to meet you. I'm Moran, a caretaker with the Square Maintenance Department. If you have any identification, I may be able to help further...
You're the one who led us to victory at Moros. It's an honor to meet you.
strings.모란, 저도 만나서 반가워요. 그런데 절 어떻게 아셨어요?: It's good to meet you, too, Moran. How did you know about me?
strings.관청에서 일하고 있는 사람들에게는 유명하십니다. 일반 주민들도 알고 있을: You're well known among those of us who work for the government. I believe ordinary citizens know you, too.
I've finished cleaning LaChouette and was about to return to the square. Good timing. Follow me.
Thank you, Moran. And thank you, Daisy.
Of course. It's my job. Oh, Daisy, a word before I go.
strings.길거리 공연도 관리부 허가 필요한 거 알고 있지?: You know you need a permit from the department for street performances, too?
strings.그래서 서류 들고 가서 허가받았어. 여기 봐. 그런데, 서류 중에 이런건: I brought the paperwork and got one. Look. But why was this in the forms?
strings.(데이지가 기타 케이스에서 허가서로 보이는 종이를 꺼내 모란에게 보여준다: (Daisy takes what appears to be a permit from her guitar case and shows Moran.)
strings.…미안, 비둘기 모이 주지 말기 서약서까지 있을 줄 몰랐네. 그래도 이미: ...Sorry. I didn't know they'd included a pledge not to feed the pigeons. Though perhaps it's because of your past record?
strings.아하하…. 조금 밖에 안 줬는데…. 그것도 다 래츠시가 다 들고 가더라…: Ahaha... I only gave them a little... And Ratsy took it all anyway...
strings.알았어, 알았어. 전처럼 밤이 깊어질 때까지 노래 부르지 말고, 해가 지: All right, all right. Don't sing late into the night like last time. Head home before sunset. Even if the neighbors enjoy your music, don't overdo it.
But I want to see the merry owls come out to play. What a shame.
strings.네가 노래하는 이유가 라슈에트라는 건 알지만, 그게 라슈에트를 힘들게 할: I know you sing for LaChouette, but you could end up making things harder for it.
strings.최악의 경우, 라슈에트에서도 길거리 공연을 막는 그런 이야기가 나올지 몰: At worst, people might start calling for a ban on street performances here, too.
strings.어, 광장 같은 곳에서는 못하는 건가요?: Wait, you can't perform in places like the square?
strings.최근에 의회에서 소음을 유발한다는 이야기가 나와서 광장을 비롯해 대형 공: The council recently claimed it caused too much noise. Now performances in the square and all large shows are banned.
We have an outdoor theater that holds thousands, and an opera house, too...
strings.소음 문제는 아닌 것 같습니다. 예전에 유명한 분들이 공연했을 때도 아무: I doubt noise is the real problem. No one complained when famous performers appeared before.
Moran, I know you're busy, but stay for one song. You like my music. %s, you stay for a song too, %s.
Daisy, we'll listen from the back, then head to the square after one song.
strings.고마워. 이제 나 준비할 거야. 여기서 딱 지켜봐. 알았지?: Thank you. I'll get ready. Stay right there and watch, okay?
strings.(데이지가 환하게 웃으며 미리 봐둔 장소로 총총 뛰어간다. 언제 사람들이: (Daisy beams and skips to the spot she picked out. A crowd has already gathered, calling her name.)
strings.둘, 셋! 안녕하세요! 데이지입니다!: Two, three! Hello, everyone! I'm Daisy!
strings.와아. 라슈에트! 정말 오랜만이에요. 다들 그동안 저 잊은 건 아니겠죠?: Wow! LaChouette, it's been so long! You haven't forgotten me, have you? It's all right if you have. After today, you'll never forget me again!
strings.그리고 식사는 하셨어요? 아아, 제 노래 들으시고 맛있는 거 드세요. 약: Have you eaten? Listen to my song, then get yourselves something delicious. Promise!
Ah, my opening speech is getting long today. Hehe.
strings.(데이지가 피크를 들어 기타 줄을 살며시 튕긴다.): (Daisy raises her pick and gently strums the guitar.)
strings.(단 한 소절 부른 것뿐이지만, 데이지를 지켜보고 있던 사람들이 환호성을: (She has sung only one phrase, but the crowd erupts in cheers.)
strings.라슈에트 라 비타…♬ 눈을 뜨고 있어도, 눈을 감고 있어도. 유쾌한 부엉: La Chouette La Vita... ♬ Eyes open, eyes closed, the merry owl dreams ♪ and sings ♩
strings.새장 속에 가두려고 하지 마♬: Don't try to lock me in a cage ♬
strings.(잔잔하게 시작했던 노래는 점점 격정적으로 변해 듣는 사람의 심장을 더욱: (The song, gentle at first, grows passionate, making the listeners' hearts beat faster.)
Woooow... I love this. It's incredible...
strings.정말 대단하지 않습니까? 라슈에트에서 나고 자란 아이가 저렇게 희망을 놓: Isn't she remarkable? A girl born and raised in LaChouette, still singing without losing hope...
I'm lucky to hear such a wonderful song on my first visit to Glaston.
Ah, I don't think we need to stay for the next song.
strings.한 곡 더 듣고 싶긴 하지만, 이만 갈까요?: I'd like to hear one more, but shall we go?
Sorry, Daisy, but I'm not fond of the next song's title.
strings.다음 곡은 [8인 던전에 들어갔는데, 파티원들이 다 죽고 나만 살아남아: The next song is [I Entered an Eight-Person Dungeon, My Entire Party Died, and I Was the Only One Left to Face the Boss].
strings.아시는 분은 다 같이 불러요!: If you know it, sing along!
Let's go. The square is that way.
strings.(정비되지 않은 길과 좁은 골목, 높은 계단을 연이어 지나가고 나서야 다: (After rough roads, narrow alleys, and long flights of stairs, they emerge onto a street with an entirely different atmosphere.)
strings.(라슈에트 거리가 도시의 그림자 같은 곳이었다면 새롭게 발을 내디딘 구역: (If LaChouette was the city's shadow, this new district is the sun shining in a morning sky.)
strings.(사람들을 기다리고 있었다는 것처럼 마침 중앙에 세워진 세이렌 분수대에서: (As though welcoming them, the siren fountain at the center sends jets of water into the air.)
strings.(그러자 맑고 깨끗한 하늘 아래 떠오른 무지개가 황성과 겹쳐진다.): (A rainbow rises beneath the clear sky, arching across the imperial palace.)
strings.(많은 사람들이 각자의 목적을 위해 광장을 오가는 모습에 활기가 느껴진다: (People cross the square on their various errands, filling it with life.)
It's enormous. Roads here, roads there...
strings.저쪽은 황성과 행정지구로 가는 길입니다. 이쪽은 주택 지구와 공방 거리,: That way leads to the palace and administrative district. This way is the residential district and the workshops. And over there...
strings.(모란이 여기저기 구경하느라 정신없는 %s에게 광장의 길을 설명한다.): (Moran explains the square's streets as %s looks around in fascination.)
strings.그래도 잘 모르겠다 싶으면 분수대 앞으로 가시면 됩니다. 거기선 다른 구: If you're still unsure, go to the fountain. You can see the paths to the other districts clearly from there.
There's so much to see in the central square. I got distracted for a moment.
Haha, that's all right. Everyone reacts that way on their first visit.
Can I help with anything else? You seemed to be looking for something...
strings.부탁 받은 일이 있어서 누굴 찾고 있었어요. 광장에서 자주 나온다는 이야: Someone asked me to find a person. I heard she's often in the square...
I may be able to help if you tell me her name.
strings.아, 실비아. 황성 기사단 붉은 달의 상처의 아르젠트 단장님 동생 말씀이: Ah, Silvia. The younger sister of Argent, commander of the imperial knights, the Scar of the Red Moon?
strings.그 친구가 데이지 팬이어서 아마 라슈에트에 있었을 겁니다. 하는 일이 자: She's a fan of Daisy's, so she was probably in LaChouette. Her work allows her some freedom. I expect she went to watch.
I don't quite have time to fetch her...
It's all right, Moran. I'll find her.
strings.실비아는 광장이 가까운 관청 건물에서 일하는데, 종종 밖으로 나와 휴식하: She works in a government building near the square and often steps outside for a break.
Glad to help. Haha. Oh, look at the time.
strings.(모란이 그 말과 함께 품 안에서 안경과 마스크를 꺼내 쓴다.): (Moran takes glasses and a mask from his clothes and puts them on.)
strings.광장 집중 정비 시간이라 이만 가봐야 할 것 같습니다. %s 님, 그러면: It's time for the square's intensive cleaning, so I should go. Enjoy your time in Glaston, %s.
strings.나중에라도 도움이 필요하신 일이 있으시면 절 찾아오시거나 행정 지구 안에: If you need help later, come find me, or visit the second-floor office in the Imperial Environment Bureau in the administrative district.
strings.(저렇게 친절한 사람은 오랜만이네….): (It's been a while since I met someone so kind...)
strings.(모란이 떠나고 광장을 다시 둘러보고 있는 %s의 시야에 높은 곳에 있는: (After Moran leaves, %s surveys the square again. The palace high above catches their eye.)
strings.저기가 폐하가 계신 황성이란 말이지…. 하얗고 아름답고, 웅장하기까지 하: So that's where Her Majesty lives... White, beautiful, and magnificent.
The square is lovely, too. It would be nice just to take a walk. But...
strings.(여기에 예지 속 신급 존재가 나타난다는 건가….): (That godlike being from the vision is going to appear here...)
strings.(…일단 광장을 돌아다니면서 사람들에게 정보를 모아보자. 사소한 것들이라: (...Let's ask around the square. Even small details might add up to something.)
strings.(광장 한쪽에 세워진 세이렌 석상 근처가 조용하다. 머릿속이 복잡해진 %: (The area around a siren statue at one side of the square is quiet. With thoughts crowding their mind, %s naturally heads toward it.)
strings.(잠깐, 앉아서 생각을 정리해야겠다.): (I should sit down and sort through what I've learned.)
strings.(라슈에트의 어딘가로 숨은 살인귀, 라슈에트 지하수로에서 들려오는 누군가: (A murderer hiding somewhere in LaChouette. A voice from its underground waterways...)
strings.(라슈에트의 골목에서 발견된 노네임, 수상한 돌고래, 글래스턴에 하늘 위: (No Name seen in a LaChouette alley. A suspicious dolphin. A strange space floating above Glaston... And a Bureau mage who spoke of Pandemonium as though it were nothing...)
strings.(단서들을 토대로 어떤 장소에 먼저 갈지 결정하자.): (Let's use these clues to decide where to go first.)
strings.(얼핏 봤지만, 라슈에트 골목이 엄청 많던데…. 다 돌아다니려면 얼마나: (I only had a glimpse, but LaChouette has so many alleys... How long would it take to search them all?)
strings.(아직 여유가 있긴 하지만, 전부 다 찾아볼 수 있을지 모르겠네.. 지금: (There's still some time, but I don't know if I can check every one. Word of my arrival in Glaston must be spreading by now...)
strings.(수상한 일이 일어나도 이상하지 않은 특정 장소…. 역시 수로겠지.): (A place where suspicious things could happen without seeming out of place... The waterways.)
strings.(이리스가 보여준 기억 속 장소도 수로에다 아이들이 들은 목소리도 수로: (The memory Iris showed me was in a waterway. The children heard the voice inside one, too.)
(I don't know about the other rumors, but I should investigate the waterways first.)
strings.(일단 수로에 가는 것도 가는 건데, 누구한테 도움을 받아야 할 것 같: (Before I go, though, I should find someone who can help...)
strings.(그렇게 고민하고 있던 %s의 귓가에 누군가의 노랫소리가 들려온다. 지나: (As %s thinks, a song reaches their ear. Someone passing by seems to be humming.)
strings.라슈에트 라 비타(La Chouette La Vita), 라 비타~♪: La Chouette La Vita, La Vita~♪
strings.(분명 어디선가 들었던 노래지만, 음정도 박자도 어긋난 흥얼거림은 원곡을: (It is a familiar tune, but the humming is so far off-key and out of rhythm that the original is almost unrecognizable.)
strings.(%s의 외침과 함께 지나가던 사람이 놀라 주위를 두리번거린다.): (At %s's exclamation, the passerby looks around in surprise.)
Thank you. It sounded so different, I wasn't sure...
strings.(태양처럼 붉은 머리, 파란 눈동자, 무표정, 위치는 다르지만 얼굴에 매: (A girl regards the adventurer. Hair red as the sun, blue eyes, an impassive face, and a charming beauty mark in a slightly different spot. She bears a striking resemblance to someone.)
strings.제가 실비아가 맞긴 한데, 저를 아시나요?: I am Silvia. Do we know each other?
Dayna said to look for someone who looks unmistakably like Argent...
strings.(실비아가 고개를 잠깐 돌리더니 한숨을 내쉰다.): (Silvia turns her head briefly and sighs.)
strings.황녀님, 아니. 데이나 언니께서 그렇게 말한 거라면 어쩔 수 없죠. 일단: If the princess... I mean, Dayna, put it that way, I suppose there's nothing I can do. Follow me.
strings.(모든 일에 마법청의 마법사들이 관여한 건 사실이지만….): (It's true the Bureau's mages have been involved in everything...)
strings.(단서가 많이 부족해. 이것만 가지고는 마법청으로는 갈 수 없어….): (But I don't have enough evidence. I can't go to the Bureau with this alone...)
strings.(잘못 움직였다가는 나르샤가 위험할 수도 있고….): (One wrong move could put Narsha in danger...)
strings.(갑자기 생각 좀 하려니 배고파지네.): (All this thinking has made me hungry.)
strings.(아, 젤릭이 나르샤에게 한가득 안겨준 음식들이 있었지. 마침 배고팠는데: (Oh, Jelic gave Narsha a mountain of food. Perfect timing.)
strings.(먹었으니 제대로 좀 생각해 보자….): (Now that I've eaten, let's think properly...)
strings.(얼핏 봤지만, 라슈에트 골목이 엄청 많던데…. 다 돌아다니면 얼마나 걸: (I only had a glimpse, but LaChouette has so many alleys... How long would searching all of them take?)
strings.(다른 이야기들은 잘 모르겠지만, 일단 수로부터 조사해 볼 필요가 있겠어: (I don't know about the other rumors, but the waterways need investigating first.)
strings.(광장에서 다른 구역으로 가는 길목에서 실비아의 발걸음이 멈춘다. 실비아: (At a road leading from the square to another district, Silvia stops, checks her surroundings, and looks directly at %s.)
strings.마침 쉬는 시간이라 괜찮아요. 그럼 우리 이야기해요. %s 님 말씀은 정: I'm on my break, so yes. Let's talk. I've heard so much about you, %s. I wondered who you were. Now we finally meet.
strings.아르젠트를 만나셨다면 혹시 제 이야기도 들으셨나요? 또 말 잘 안 듣는다: If you've met Argent, did he mention me? Did he say I never listen to him again?
Ahaha... He just said he had a younger sister.
strings.하아…. 이야기했네. 했어…. 어쨌든 데이나 언니 소개로 오셨으니 제대로: Haah... So he did. He definitely did. Anyway, since Dayna sent you, let me introduce myself properly. I'm Silvia, a scribe at the Imperial Archives.
strings.기록원을 모르시는 걸 보니 다른 지역에서 오셨군요. 사실, 글래스턴 주민: You must be from elsewhere if you don't know the Archives. Most people outside Glaston wouldn't know about us or our scribes.
strings.네. 워낙 작은 기관이기도 하고, 일하는 사람도 적어서요. 기록원은 제국: Yes. We're a small institution with few staff. Every day, we record events in the Empire in books, magical devices, and so on.
We've existed since the Kingdom of Silvaria became an empire. Quite a long time.
strings.저는 글씨, 즉 필사로 기록을 남기는 일을 하는 필사원이에요. 말단 중의: As a scribe, I keep written records by hand. I'm at the very bottom of the ranks, but I find it interesting. I enjoy it.
strings.아! 기록원이라면 그런 것도 있나요? 라슈에트에 있는 수로 지도라던가 갈: Oh! Would the Archives have maps of LaChouette's waterways, or records of paths into them?
strings.물론 있죠. 데이나 언니께서 %s 님을 도우라고 했던 말이 그런 거였나: Of course. That must be what Dayna meant when she asked me to help you, %s.
strings.황녀님 일을 왜 이야기하지 않았냐고요. 데이나 언니 이야기만 나오면 밑도: He'll ask why I didn't tell him I was working for the princess. The moment Dayna is involved, his questions never end.
strings.어차피 나중에 알게 되긴 할 거예요. 그게 누구 입에서 나오냐가 관건인: He'll find out eventually. What matters is who tells him. If it's Dayna or Her Majesty, that's fine...
strings.저나 다른 사람이라면 혼난다는 거죠?: But if it's me or anyone else, you'll get a lecture?
strings.네…, 잔소리가 너무 심해요. 친구 오빠들은 안 그러던데. 우우, 아르젠: Yes... He nags so much. My friends' brothers don't act like that. Ugh, enough about Argent.
I'll look for records on Glaston's underground waterways.
strings.혹시 데이지 언니 아세요?: Do you know Daisy, by any chance?
strings.라슈에트에 갔을 때, 모란의 소개로 인사했었어요. 길거리 공연하는 것도: I met her through Moran when I went to LaChouette. I saw her perform in the street, too.
strings.그러면 제가 내일 일 정리하고, 데이지 언니가 공연하던 그 자리로 갈게요: Then tomorrow, once I've sorted out my work, I'll meet you where she was performing.
If you really want to thank me, buy me a gelato sometime. See you tomorrow, %s.
strings.(흐음, 오늘 더는 할 수 있는 일이 없네. 이만 쉬어야겠다. 나르샤가: (Hmm. There's nothing more I can do today. I should rest. Narsha's inn was this way, wasn't it?)
Things seem to be going rather smoothly...
I didn't know you'd be staying here, too. Is your work taking a while?
(Munching on a piece of bread from the inn, Narsha steps outside with the adventurer.)
strings.아직 여유 있으니까 괜찮아요. 나르샤는 어제 일 보고 온 거 아니었어요?: There's still time, so it's fine. Didn't you take care of your business yesterday?
strings.레이븐 마법사님께서 사람을 보내셔서 바로 갈 줄 알았거든요. 하루만 기다: Raven sent someone, so I thought we'd go straight away. But he asked me to wait a day. I just lazed around my room.
strings.(나르샤가 작은 입으로 빵을 베어 물고는 만족스러운지 활짝 웃는다.): (Narsha takes a small bite of bread and smiles happily.)
Good food always lifts my spirits.
strings.(그런 그때, 멀리서 안경을 쓴 한 남자가 두 사람이 있는 곳을 향해 손: (A man wearing glasses waves to them from a distance.)
Narsha, do you know him? He seems to be greeting us.
strings.(창백한 인상의 남자 마법사가 몹시 피곤해보이는 모습으로 나르샤에게 다가: (A pale mage approaches Narsha, looking utterly exhausted.)
strings.또 밤새셨나요?: Did you stay up all night again?
strings.…흥미를 끄는 책을 발견했거든요…. 그런데 제가 밤 새운 건 어떻게 알았: ...I found an intriguing book... How did you know I'd been up all night?
strings.나르샤 양은 역시 관찰력이 뛰어나군요. …바로 이 책 때문입니다. 이 책: As observant as ever, Narsha. ...It's this book. It describes a new power within darkness—
strings.(레이븐이라는 마법사가 품안에 있던 책 한권을 들어 보인다. 책에 대해: (The mage called Raven holds up a book. As he begins to explain it, his eyes meet %s's.)
strings.일행이 계셨군요. 아, 안녕하세요. 마법청 소속 마법사 레이븐입니다. 실: You have company. Oh, hello. I'm Raven, a mage with the Magic Bureau. If I may ask your name...
strings.나르샤 양? 저는 나르샤 양도 볼 겸 여기 식사가 맛있다고 해서 먹으러…: Narsha? I came to see you, and I heard the food here was good, so I thought I'd... Mmph, mmph!
strings.(나르샤가 언제 꺼냈는지 젤릭이 만든 것으로 보이는 케이크를 냅다 레이븐: (Producing what looks like one of Jelic's cakes, Narsha stuffs it straight into Raven's mouth.)
This is delicious, too. I'll go with Raven now. See you later.
strings.(나르샤가 급하게 레이븐을 끌고 라슈에트 거리를 빠져나간다.): (Narsha hurriedly drags Raven out of LaChouette.)
strings.(마법사들과 괜히 접촉하지 말라는 나르샤의 배려겠지….): (She's trying to spare me unnecessary contact with the Bureau's mages...)
strings.(라슈에트의 한쪽에서 어디선가 들었던 노랫소리가 울려 퍼진다.): (A familiar song rings out from one side of LaChouette.)
Daisy's singing? She's performing again today.
strings.(현란한 기타 연주에 이어 맑고 깨끗한 데이지의 목소리가 라슈에트 거리: (A dazzling guitar passage gives way to Daisy's clear voice, filling one corner of LaChouette.)
strings.(빈민가 라슈에트에서 무슨 공연이냐며 그냥 지나치려 했던 사람들이 데이지: (Passersby who had dismissed the idea of a performance in the slums stop in their tracks when they hear her.)
strings.(그렇게 데이지의 노래가 끝나자 누가 먼저랄 것도 없이 다들 환호를 보낸: (As the song ends, cheers rise from every side.)
strings.사랑해요, 데이지!! 꽃보다 데이지!!: We love you, Daisy! Daisy outshines every flower!
strings.꽃 돼지, 아니고 꽃 데이지랍니다. 파픈스타 데이지!: You're calling me a flower, not a pig, right? Your Pop'n Star, Daisy!
strings.(데이지가 간단한 멘트와 함께 다음 곡을 이어간다. 이번 노래도 방금 불: (After a quick remark, Daisy launches into the next song, just as energetic as the last.)
She's incredible... I don't know how to describe it...
strings.맑고 깨끗한 유리구슬이 또르르 흘러가는 것 같죠? 튼튼해서 오래 굴러가는: Like a clear glass marble rolling along, right? A sturdy one that keeps rolling forever! Then it bounces so high! All the way to the sky!
And when it falls, it lands right in my heart...
strings.무슨 말이에요, 실비아?: What are you talking about, Silvia?
strings.이렇게 고운 목소리로 노래를 부르는 사람이 심지어 예쁘고 귀엽잖아요! 제: Someone who sings with such a beautiful voice is also so pretty and cute! Even her smallest gestures are adorable... Wow...
strings.(데이지를 설명하는 실비아의 얼굴에 작은 미소가 피어난다.): (A small smile blooms on Silvia's face as she talks about Daisy.)
strings.오빠 잔소리에 지쳐서 광장에 나와 그냥 멍하니 있었는데, 어디서 천상의: I was worn out by my brother's nagging and standing in the square, staring into space. Then I heard this heavenly voice.
strings.이거다, 이거야. 여신님이 내게 축복을 내려준 거야, 하고 쫓아가서 들어: I thought, 'This is it! The goddess has blessed me!' So I followed the sound...
Sorry. I lose my head whenever Daisy comes up.
strings.여기 말씀하신 자료에요. 라슈에트에서 수로로 이어지는 골목 지도부터 수로: Here are the records you asked for. A map of the alleys leading to LaChouette's waterways, plans of the waterways themselves...
strings.라슈에트의 수로 이야기를 하셔서 관련된 기록을 좀 더 찾아봤어요. 살인귀: Since you mentioned the waterways, I looked for related records, too. I found an account of the knights' confrontation with the murderer Gentleman and copied it down.
strings.이 많은 걸 다 적어 온 거예요? 지도도 그려오고?: You copied all of this? And drew the maps?
strings.옮겨 적고 그리는 게 일이라 다 할 수 있었어요. 열람하는 권한만 있는: Copying text and drawings is my job, so I managed. It's a shame I'm only allowed to consult the originals.
strings.위험한 일이냐고 물어봐도, 분명 아니라고 하실 것 같아서…. 오빠도 항상: If I ask whether it's dangerous, you'll say no, won't you? My brother always does.
Daisy's performance is over, so I should go.
strings.(실비아가 작은 미소로 인사한 후, 서둘러 광장으로 올라간다.): (Silvia says goodbye with a small smile and hurries up to the square.)
That's a lot of material. Let's take a look...
(The account of Gentleman is much the same as what Manuel told me. Was that his name? But why are these waterway plans so complicated? Ah, here...)
strings.(현재 라슈에트 수로 정비는 북쪽으로 진입해서 가능. 남쪽은 오랫동안 사: ('Current maintenance access to LaChouette's waterways is from the north. Southern access is closed after prolonged disuse,' it says.)
strings.(아이들이 내려간 곳은 북쪽, 그러면 남쪽으로 가보자.): (The children went down through the north. I'll try the south.)
strings.(도면과 지도에 체크한 골목으로 발걸음을 옮기려고 할 때, 누군가 %s의: (As %s starts toward the alley marked on the map and plans, someone catches their clothes.)
%s, I can sense magic where you're headed. Wait a little before you go.
strings.(고개를 들어 앞을 바라보자 골목 방향에서 방금 전까지 보이지 않았던 그: (Looking up, the adventurer sees shadows spreading from the alley, where none were visible a moment before.)
strings.마법청사가 있는 행정 지구 쪽에서 일시적으로, 지진처럼 살짝 흔들리는 경: Sometimes there's a brief tremor from the administrative district, where the Magic Bureau is. Like a little earthquake. It's caused by tangled currents of magic...
strings.데이지는 그런 걸 어떻게 알아요?: How do you know about that, Daisy?
strings.저 마법학원 제레니스 출신이에요! 좋은 성적은 아니었지만, 그 정도는 알: I graduated from Jerenis Magic Academy! My grades weren't great, but I know that much.
strings.선생님들이 마법청에 강한 마력 도구 같은 게 있어서 종종 마력 흐름이 슝: The teachers said the Bureau has powerful magical devices that can make the flow of magic suddenly surge.
strings.위험할 정도는 아니라는데, 또 마력이란 게 완벽하게 안전한 것도 아니잖아: They said it wasn't dangerous, but magic is never completely safe, is it?
It fades quickly, so they told us to wait until it's gone before passing through.
Daisy? It's all right. Tell me.
strings.네…. 언제부턴가 라슈에트에 마력이 퍼지지 않고 모여 있었어요. 이게 금: Well... At some point, magic began to gather in LaChouette instead of dispersing. Normally it should fade quickly, but it stayed.
strings.이상했어요. 그냥 은은하게 흐르는 마력도 아니고, 뭉쳐져 계속 신경 쓰일: It was strange. Not a gentle current, but dense clumps spread all over LaChouette. Strong enough that I couldn't stop noticing them.
So I kept filing complaints with the Magic Bureau, asking them to do something.
strings.마법청에서선 아무것도 아니라고 넘어가려고 해서 계속 항의했어요. 제가 마: They tried to dismiss it as nothing, so I kept protesting. Maybe they were concerned because I studied at the academy. They eventually sent mages to do something...
But hardly anything changed. How long are they going to keep treating LaChouette this way... ?
In the end, I paid to make a whole lot of magical tools myself.
strings.(데이지가 %s의 손에 뭔가 잔뜩 쥐여준다.): (Daisy presses a handful of things into %s's hands.)
Stickers? Oh, with your face on them.
strings.귀엽죠? 이게 단가가 괜찮고, 굿즈 느낌이 가득해요. 가볍게 붙일 수 있: Cute, right? They're affordable to make and feel like proper merchandise. Easy to stick anywhere, too.
strings.라슈에트 사람들하고 팬분들이 여기 저기 잔뜩 붙이니까 마력이 조금 흩어지: The people of LaChouette and my fans put them up everywhere, and the magic seems to be dispersing a little. Only a little, though...
strings.공연 횟수를 조금 더 늘리고, 스티커도 좀 더 만들어서 계속 붙이다 보면: If I perform more often, make more stickers, and keep putting them up, perhaps that strange magic will finally clear out.
Huh? Are the stickers working better? A lot more magic has dispersed.
strings.이제 가도 되겠죠? 데이지, 혹시 모르니까 제가 저쪽 골목 가면서 좀 더: It should be safe to go now, right? Daisy, I'll put up a few more as I walk through the alley, just in case.
strings.그래 주실래요? 고마워요, %s 님! %s 님만 믿을게요!: Would you? Thank you, %s! I'm counting on you, %s!
strings.(데이지가 %s에게 스티커를 나눠주자, 멀리서 이 광경을 본 사람들이 몰: (Seeing Daisy give stickers to %s, people in the distance flock over.)
strings.으아아아, 잠깐만요! 매니저 좀 불러주세요! 매니저! 아, 나 매니저 없: Aaaaah, wait! Someone get my manager! Manager! Oh, right. I don't have one. Form a line, please!
strings.데이지가 직접 스티커 나눠 드릴게요!: Daisy will hand out the stickers herself!
strings.(데이지의 말 한 마디에 조금 전까지 우왕좌왕했던 사람들이 일사불란하게: (At her words, the milling crowd forms an orderly queue. It seems long enough to reach the central square.)
strings.(아, 이러고 있을 때가 아니지. 골목으로 들어가 보자. 일단 들어가서: (No time to stand around. Let's enter the alley and see what's there.)
strings.(모험가의 발걸음이 골목에 닿는 순간, 머물러 있던 그림자가 알 수 없는: (The moment the adventurer steps into the alley, the lingering shadows scatter an unfamiliar darkness and vanish.)
strings.(어둠을 헤치고 나아간 길 끝에서 본 라슈에트 거리는 분명 아는 장소였지: (Beyond the darkness, LaChouette's familiar streets feel profoundly different.)
strings.아무도 없어. 여기가 이면인가…. 윽, 이 냄새는 뭐지?: No one's here. Is this the Other Side...? Ugh, what's that smell?
strings.(평소에는 경험할 수 없었던 코를 찌르는 지독한 냄새가 흘러나오고, 자연: (An unusually foul stench stings the nose. Instinctively, a hand rises to cover mouth and nose.)
strings.(어느 정도 냄새가 사라졌다고 생각되는 순간, 손을 치워보지만 여전히 잔: (When the smell seems to have faded, the adventurer lowers their hand. But an unpleasant trace still lingers.)
strings.…이건 보통 하수도 냄새가 아니야. 이면에 가득하게 냄새가 퍼져 있다는: ...This isn't an ordinary sewer smell. If it fills the Other Side, then it must be coming from beneath the waterways...
I should check the route again before—
strings.(실비아가 전해준 자료를 펼쳐 보려고 하던 중, 누군가 %s의 앞에 나타: (As %s starts to unfold Silvia's records, someone appears before them.)
Rico? What are you doing here... ?
...I wondered who it was. It's you, %s.
strings.제가 그곳까지 안내할게요. 자세한 건 가서 말씀드릴게요. 그리고 그곳에: I'll guide you there. I'll explain once we arrive. Until then, anything that stands in our way...
strings.…모두 적이에요. 우리가 모르는 세계에서 온, 우리를 적으로 여기는 존재: ...Is an enemy. Beings from an unknown world that regard us as foes.
They seem even more alert now that you've arrived, %s.
strings.(리코타를 따라 도착한 골목 구석. 안쪽으로 커다란 맨홀 뚜껑 하나가 반: (Licota leads the way to a corner of an alley. Farther in, a large manhole cover stands half open.)
So that's the way into the underground waterways. Thank you, Rico.
You won't be able to enter straight away.
Something like an invisible barrier is covering the entrance.
strings.(리코타의 말대로 맨홀 앞으로 다가가자 뭔가에 가로막혀 밀려난다.): (As Licota said, something blocks the adventurer's approach and pushes them back.)
strings.리코 말대로네. 어떻게 하지?: You're right. What do we do?
There must be a way down somewhere in this space.
We'll have to look. But Rico...
I was just about to explain.
strings.저번에 %s 님과 헤어지고, 글래스턴을 거쳐 다른 지역에 가려던 중에 이: After we last parted, %s, I discovered this place while passing through Glaston on my way elsewhere.
strings.바랄이라는 남자를 아실 테니, 그냥 말씀드릴게요. 총장님의 명으로 바랄의: You know the man called Baral, so I'll be direct. I was following him on the President's orders, but lost him.
I recently saw him in Vayuna Canyon...
strings.(리코타에게 바유나 협곡에서 바랄을 보고 겪었던 일을 간단하게 이야기한다: (I briefly tell Licota what happened with Baral in Vayuna Canyon.)
...He went there and did all that...
strings.리코, 조금 더 자세하게 이야기해줄 수 있어요?: Could you tell me a little more, Rico?
strings.안 그래도 전적이 있던 바랄이 프레이오스 대륙에 있는 이면을 차례차례 돌: Given his history, we were already watching him. He was visiting one Other Side after another across Freios.
He's been to several of them already.
strings.그러다가 글래스턴으로 가는 걸 보고 쫓아 갔는데, 그동안 보이지 않았던: Then I saw him heading for Glaston and followed. That's how I found the Other Side that had remained hidden until now.
strings.글래스턴의 이면이 왜 그동안 보이지 않았던 걸까요? 보통의 이면이라면 전: Why couldn't I see Glaston's Other Side before? If it were ordinary, I should have discovered it long ago...
strings.지금 글래스턴의 이면이 인간을 초월한 존재의 제어를 받고 있는 것 같아요: It seems to be under the control of something beyond human...
What? Wait. I need a moment to take that in...
Then the reason I couldn't find the Other Side, and the reason I lost Baral...
strings.바랄이 이 거리에서 뭔가 찾고 있었는데, 그것도 관련이 있을까요?: He was looking for something in these streets. Could that be connected?
Probably. I think what Baral wants is power.
Power beyond humanity. He chose to become evil to obtain it.
He must have come here because of something a Bureau mage told him.
strings.바랄이 마법청사 앞에서 어떤 마법사를 만났었는데…. 아, %s 님. 저쪽: Baral met a mage outside the Magic Bureau... Oh, %s. Someone's coming. Shh. Quiet.
strings.(리코타의 손짓에 따라 서둘러 건물 뒤로 몸을 숨기자, 어딘가를 향해 걷: (At Licota's signal, they hurry behind a building. The voices of two people walking past reach them, quiet but clear.)
strings.무무라고 이상한 소리를 내는 마족 말만 믿고 오긴 했는데…. 여기 왜 이: We came on the word of a demon who makes those strange squawking noises... But what's wrong with this place? It's clearly LaChouette. Why are there monsters?
Perhaps we should be grateful the monsters aren't noticing us.
Shh. Quiet. Keep talking, and I'll throw you in among them.
strings.(두 사람이 점점 멀어지면서 대화 내용이 더는 들려오지 않는다.): (As the pair moves away, their conversation fades beyond hearing.)
If they've come into the Other Side like this, they can't be here on ordinary business...
There are more enemies ahead. Be careful. I'll lead.
An abandoned house... Whether it holds anything, as that demon claimed, I can't say.
strings.뭐가 있긴 있을 거야. 지금까지 다니엘 군이 이야기했던 것들 거의 다 맞: There must be something. Almost everything Daniel has told us has been right.
Giving us better information than most humans, so readily...
He's safe in Invernel now. That's what matters.
strings.(파르밀라가 금방이라도 무너질 것 같이 보이는 폐가에 다가선다. 그리고: (Parmila approaches the abandoned house, which looks ready to collapse. She raises her head and murmurs.)
What are you two doing here... ?
strings.리코도 알고 있군요. 이 두 사람은 오스큐라스 용병단 소속 단장 파르밀라: You know them, too, Rico? Commander Parmila and Callone, of the Oscuras Mercenaries.
Callone, from the private magic research institute...
I don't know how you know that, but that's my past...
You never received a dismissal notice. Technically, you still work there.
strings.아직 파견 중이니까 용병단에 무슨 일이 생기면 칼로네는 잠깐 뒤로 물러나: You're still on assignment, so if anything happens to the mercenaries, you can step back for a while.
strings.단장, 무슨 말씀을 그렇게…. 제가 그렇게 매정한 사람으로 보입니까?: Commander, how can you say that? Do I look so heartless to you?
strings.마족에게서 얻은 정보가 정확하단 이야기를 들었습니다. 두 사람은 뭘 찾고: I heard you say the demon's information was accurate. What were you looking for?
strings.이야기가 긴데, 문라이트 단원도 들을래?: It's a long story. Want to hear it too, Moonlight member?
strings.문라이트도 알고 계시는군요. 그럼 들어볼까요…?: You know about Moonlight as well. Then let's hear it.
strings.(파르밀라가 리코타와 %s에게 자신이 이곳에 온 이유를 설명한다.): (Parmila explains to Licota and %s why she came here.)
strings.잠시 정리를 해야겠어요. 그러니까 파르밀라 님. 당신은 남들이 보지 못하: Let me sort this out. Parmila, you can see what others can't see, hear what they can't hear, and find what they can't find?
Yes, exactly. And I'm not a witch or anything, so don't worry.
strings.%s 님을 알기 전까진, 그러니까 정확히는 칼로네 님과 엮이기 전까진 용: Before you met %s... More precisely, before you became involved with Callone, you intended to live quietly as the mercenaries' commander.
strings.이렇게 있기엔 너무 우연이 겹치는 일이 많아서 직접 나섰고, 칼로네 님과: But too many coincidences piled up for you to stay put. You and Callone started looking for clues...
strings.여기까지 오게 된 거…, 맞죠…?: And that brought you here. Correct?
strings.그래, 맞아. 헤에, 문라이트 친구. 정리 잘하네. 그러다 보니 마녀도: Yes, exactly. Heh, you're good at summing things up, Moonlight friend. Along the way, we found a witch, too.
strings.왠지 모르게 %s에게는 이야기해야 할 것 같아서 말이야. 둘이 비슷한 느: For some reason, I felt I should tell you about her, %s. You two have a similar air about you.
strings.언젠가 예쁜 오빠가 날 찾아와서 도망 다니는 마녀를 찾아보라고 돈을 줬어: A pretty man came to see me once and paid me to find a witch on the run. A very pretty man...? Oh, wait...
strings.아닌데, 토끼 귀를 가진 언니였나…. 어, 누구였지? 칼로네, 기억나?: No, was it a woman with rabbit ears...? Who was it? Callone, do you remember?
strings.우리 항상 함께였는데, 왜 기억에 없는 거야?: We're always together. How can you not remember?
The funny thing is, I was supposed to give the witch a choice if I found her.
Come with us, or keep running.
An offer no one would be likely to accept...
strings.어쨌든 그래서 그 마녀는 따라오지 않았어. 따라오지 않으면서 의뢰는 자동: Anyway, she didn't come. And when she refused, the commission was automatically canceled.
strings.그런데 그 마녀가 따라갔으면 어디로 데리고 가려고 했어요?: If she had agreed, where would you have taken her?
strings.아하하, 모르겠어. 기억이 나질 않네. 그래도 중요한 건 잊지 않아서 다: Ahaha, I don't know. I can't remember. At least I haven't forgotten the important part.
strings.사실 나는 사람을 찾고 있어. 그 사람뿐만 아니라 많은 사람들이 모두의: I'm looking for someone. Not just one person, either. Many people have vanished from everyone's memories.
Only a handful of us remember.
strings.나는 기억하는데, 다른 사람들이 기억하지 못하는 그런 세계가 왜 있는 건: Why is there a world where I remember them, but everyone else has forgotten...? Haah...
strings.어쨌든 오르카리움에서 사고가 났단 말을 듣고, 뭔가 찾을 수 있을것 같아: Anyway, I heard about the incident in Orcarium and thought I might find something there. The Bureau's mages couldn't have been killed for no reason.
That's where I met Daniel, the demon reporter. Squawk.
strings.월간 로젠가르텐 편집부 출신 기자 다니엘?: Daniel, the reporter from Monthly Rosengarten?
strings.응, 앵무 기자. 죽기 싫으면 정보를 내놓으라니까 괜찮은 것들을 주더라고: Yes, the parrot reporter. I told him to give me information if he wanted to live. He had some good stuff.
strings.%s, 어느 정도는 다 알고 있지? 마녀에 관련된 이야기 말이야. 어떤: You know some of it already, don't you, %s? About the witches. One witch is gathering the others...
And Aaron, the council chairman, wants to use them...
And the place the missing people went is somewhere in Glaston.
strings.마족이니까 의심스러워서 다니엘 군이 이야기한 걸 몇 가지 확인해 봤는데,: He's a demon, so I was suspicious. I checked a few things he told me. They were all true.
strings.사라진 사람을 혼자 기억하는 사람들을 만나서 이야기를 들어보니까 다니엘: I met people who were the only ones to remember someone who vanished. Their stories confirmed his information.
He said, 'Something's strange about that abandoned house in LaChouette, squawk. I haven't gone in. Could be dangerous, squawk.' So here we are.
He said even a weak demon has the advantage of entering places like this easily.
strings.…이면에 원래 악마나 마족들도 들어오고 그러니까요. 뒤틀린 그림자에 영향: ...Devils and demons can enter the Other Side naturally. So can I, having been affected by the Twisted Shadow...
The Other Side... An unfamiliar concept, but I think I understand.
strings.여기까지 왔으니까 같이 들어가자. 두 사람도 목적이 있어서 온 거 아냐?: Since we're all here, let's go in together. You two have a reason for coming, don't you?
strings.%s 님, 어떻게 할까요? 그 앵무 기자의 정보가 정확하다면 여기 뭔가: What do you think, %s? If the parrot reporter's information is accurate, there may be something here...
strings.둘보단 셋, 셋보단 넷이 낫지 않아?: Three is better than two, and four is better than three, right?
strings.%s 님, 부탁드립니다. 왠지 단장이 사고칠 것 같은 예감이 들어서 함께: Please join us, %s. I have a feeling the commander is about to cause trouble.
strings.…알았어요. 어차피 저와 리코도 막혀있는 수로로 갈 방법을 찾고 있었어요: ...All right. Rico and I were looking for a way into the blocked waterways anyway. This place might hold the answer.
Thank you, %s. We won't follow you into the waterways.
strings.두 분, 제가 앞에 설 테니 따라오세요. %s 님께서 뒤를 맡아주실 거예: I'll take the lead. Follow me. %s will guard the rear.
strings.(그렇게 네 사람이 폐가의 반쯤 열린 문을 밀고 차례차례 안으로 들어간다: (The four push open the house's half-closed door and enter one by one.)
strings.(마지막으로 모험가가 발을 내딛는 순간, 갑자기 눈을 찌를 정도의 강렬한: (As the adventurer steps in last, an intense light rushes toward them, painfully bright.)
strings.(두 팔을 들어 얼굴을 가리지만 여전히 강렬한 빛이 다가온다. 그렇게 몇: (Both arms rise to shield the face, but the fierce light presses on. A few more steps bring an uncanny silence, as though no one else is there.)
strings.(들었던 팔을 내리자 빛이 물러난 공간엔 깊은 어둠만이 남아있다. 여전히: (Lowering their arms, the adventurer finds the light gone, leaving only deep darkness. Nothing can be made out in the silent space.)
strings.분명 안은 보통 집안처럼 보였는데…. 어?: It looked like an ordinary house inside... Huh?
strings.(그저 발을 한 걸음 앞으로 내딛으려고 했을 뿐이지만, %s의 몸이 그대: (As %s takes a single step forward, their body tips, falling endlessly into a depth with no floor.)
strings.(이렇게 떨어지면 커다란 소리와 함께 바닥에 부딪혀야 하는데….): (Falling like this, I should hit the ground with a huge crash...)
strings.(더는 떨어지지 않는 느낌에 감겨있던 %s의 눈이 자연스레 떠진다.): (The sensation of falling ceases, and %s's tightly shut eyes open.)
strings.(시야에 들어온 건 노란빛이 가득한 글래스턴의 모습이지만, 알고 있는 것: (Glaston fills the view, bathed in yellow light, yet somehow different from the city the adventurer knows.)
strings.(허공에서 뒤집힌 위의 글래스턴, 마치 뒤집힌 것처럼 잔해를 떨어뜨려 보: (An inverted Glaston hangs above. Below, another Glaston sheds debris as though it, too, has been overturned.)
strings.(두 개의 도시가 위와 아래에서 마주하고 있는 세계는 그야말로 기묘한 분: (The two cities face each other, one above and one below. The world's uncanniness weighs heavily on the adventurer.)
strings.또 다른 세계에 들어온 건가? 설마, 나 혼자?: Another world? Am I alone here?
strings.(아무리 주위를 둘러봐도, 소리를 질러도 기묘한 세계 속에서 서 있는 건: (No amount of searching or shouting brings an answer. Only %s stands in this strange world.)
strings.(%s의 말과 함께 앞에 보이는 건물의 잔해 사이에서 커다란 불꽃이 일어: (At %s's words, a great flame rises among the ruins ahead.)
strings.(불꽃은 점차 사람 형태로 변하면서, 주위에 다양한 색의 빛을 머금은 구: (The flame gradually takes human form, conjuring spheres of many-colored light around itself. It slowly approaches %s.)
strings.(뭐라고 말하고 있는 거지? 분명 저건….): (What is it saying? That thing is clearly...)
strings.(불꽃에서 변화한 존재가 구체를 쓰다듬으면서 조용히 %s의 얼굴을 바라본: (The being born from the flame strokes a sphere and quietly studies %s.)
strings.지금부터 제대로 들릴 것입니다. 이제 에트와르의 언어로 이야기합니다. 당: You will hear me clearly now. I am speaking the language of Etoile. Are you the visitor who has entered this boundary?
You know nothing of this place? Then I shall explain.
strings.이 공간은 파멸을 원하는 이의 바람으로 깨어난 장소입니다. 에트와르가 아: This space awakens at the wish of one who desires destruction. It has appeared in worlds beyond Etoile and reduced all things to nothing.
Visitors from other worlds came here to protect their worlds. They believed this place held the means devised by the one who wished for destruction.
strings.방문자는 버티고 버텨 자기 세계를 구하려고 했지만, 이곳에 갇힌 채로 세: They endured and endured, trying to save their worlds. Yet they died imprisoned here, watching those worlds perish.
strings.삶과 죽음, 파멸과 지속의 순간들, 그 가운데 존재하는 이 경계에서 방문: Life and death. Destruction and continuance. In the boundary between those moments, a visitor's death becomes their star's end.
Thus the fate of destruction harbored by that star reaches the end of eternity.
strings.그러면 나 그노시스는 다시 잠에 빠져듭니다. 다시 파멸의 역사가 시작되는: Then I, Gnosis, return to sleep. When the history of destruction begins upon another star, I approach and await its visitor.
strings.(자신을 그노시스라고 부른 것 같은 존재가 뒤로 물러나 모험가를 빤히 바: (The being that called itself Gnosis steps back and regards the adventurer.)
strings.여러 파멸의 손짓을 벗어나서 그런지 몰라도, 이해가 빠릅니다. 에트와르에: You understand quickly, perhaps because you have escaped destruction's grasp so many times. Visitor from Etoile.
strings.나 그노시스는 당신이 이곳에서 아무것도 하지 않기를 원합니다. 무력함을: I, Gnosis, wish you to do nothing here. Feel your helplessness. Watch this boundary fade, and fall asleep.
A visitor who endures will witness the end of a star they never wished to see.
strings.불의 비가 내려 흔적도 없이 모두 타버린 세계. 거친 파도가 대지를 덮어: A world burned to nothing by a rain of fire. A world swept away by raging waves covering its land. A world swallowed as the earth splits in two.
strings.세상에 파멸을 원하는 사람이 어디 있어?! 그게 말이 된다고 생각해?: Who would want their world destroyed?! Do you hear yourself?
strings.있습니다. 있기에 나 그노시스가 여기 있는 것입니다. 에트와르는 산산조각: There are those who do. That is why I, Gnosis, am here. Etoile shall shatter...
strings.그만 해!! 듣기 싫어!!: Stop! I don't want to hear it!
A being from a world filled with absence cannot leave this perfect boundary. No visitor has ever escaped.
strings.난 나갈 거야. 나가야겠다고!! 가뜩이나 할 일도 많은데, 여기서 이럴: I will escape! I have to! I have too much to do to stay here!
strings.그렇습니까? 그렇게나 여기 결핍의 경계에서 나가고 싶습니까?: Is that so? You wish that strongly to leave the Boundary of the Void?
strings.할 일이 많다고 해도 여기서 끝입니다. 유감이지만, 나 그노시스는 방문자: However much you have to do, it ends here. Regrettable, but I, Gnosis, wish the visitor to accept everything.
strings.그런데, 방문자 %s…. 당신의 세계는? 이미…?: But visitor %s... Your world? Has it already... ?
(The colored spheres circling Gnosis stop. One by one, they merge into it, forming a great flame.)
What? What about my world?! Keep talking nonsense, and I'll...
strings.나 그노시스가 방문자 %s에 대해 확인할 것이 있습니다. 당신도 그 내용: I, Gnosis, have something to verify concerning visitor %s. Do you also wish to know what it is?
strings.(그노시스가 커다란 불꽃이 돼 부서진 건물의 잔해가 위로 올라가는 모습을: (Now a great flame, Gnosis watches the ruins of broken buildings rise into the air.)
Find me, Gnosis, somewhere within this boundary. Until then...
(With those words, Gnosis's flame flies toward the distant horizon and disappears.)
strings.(그러자 그동안 보이지 않았던 존재들이 하나둘씩 모습을 드러낸다.): (Beings that were invisible before begin to reveal themselves.)
I have a reason to live... To keep living. If only for that reason...
I have to get out of here.
(The destructive energy pouring over the visitor to the Boundary of the Void slowly fades. At its center stands the being that issued the challenge.)
You have come, visitor %s. I, Gnosis, shall say it again.
strings.당신이 이곳에서 아무것도 하지 않기를 원합니다. 무력함을 느낀 상태 그대: I wish you to do nothing here. Feel your helplessness. Watch this boundary fade, and fall asleep.
strings.여기까지 왔던 사람 중에 그런 선택을 한 사람이 있기나 해?: Has anyone who came this far ever chosen that?
strings.없던 것 같습니다. 그들은 끝까지 나 그노시스와 싸우다 죽었습니다. 고통: I believe not. They fought me, Gnosis, to the end and died. Writhing in agony, they watched their worlds disappear.
I offer this so you may forget even that suffering.
strings.시끄러워. 내게 뭘 알아보고 싶은 거지? 내용이 궁금하다면 찾아오라고 했: Enough. What did you want to find out about me? You told me to come if I wanted to know.
strings.(그노시스가 조용히 먼 곳을 응시한다. 그리고는 허공을 향해 오브를 든다: (Gnosis gazes quietly into the distance, then raises an orb into the air.)
strings.제안을 거절한 방문자 %s. 그건 당신의 의지가 공간을 지배하고 있는 나: Visitor %s, who has refused my offer. You will learn it if your will surpasses mine, the ruler of this space. If you defeat me.
strings.(그노시스가 들고 있던 오브로 주위에 있던 여러 개의 빛이 흘러 들어간다: (The surrounding lights flow into Gnosis's orb. It turns black and begins to radiate an ominous power.)
Before you do, the abyss will swallow everything...
strings.(검게 그을린 오브가 조금씩 먼지처럼 흩어져 간다. 오브에 다른 힘을 부: (The blackened orb crumbles like dust. Gnosis, trying to fill it with another power and set it in motion, stops.)
strings.(오브의 상태를 확인한 그노시스가 손을 뻗는다. 그러자 알 수 없는 힘이: (After examining the orb, Gnosis reaches out. An unknown force binds %s's feet as they prepare to attack.)
strings.(%s의 시야에 가득했던 결핍의 경계가 조금씩 빛을 잃는다. 그리고 그노: (The Boundary of the Void slowly loses its light around %s. Gnosis rises into the air, surveying its surroundings and %s.)
strings.당신의 의지에서 그들이 느껴집니다. 사랑했던 세계의 멸망을 바라보며 쓰러: I sense them in your will. Those who fell while watching the worlds they loved perish...
strings.그들은 사라졌지만, 의지만은 남아 다음 파멸의 운명을 구하기 위해 들어온: They are gone, but their wills remain, helping the next visitor who enters to avert a fate of destruction.
strings.(누군지는 모르겠지만, 함께 싸워줘서 고마워요….): (I don't know who you are, but thank you for fighting beside me...)
strings.그들의 의지가 당신과 함께합니다. 그래서 이 공간을 지배하는 나 그노시스: Their wills are with you. Thus they have blocked the power of Gnosis, ruler of this space.
strings.(그노시스의 불꽃이 조금씩 바람을 타고 하늘과 땅으로 흩어진다. 그리고: (Gnosis's flames scatter on the wind across sky and ground, taking hold of everything except the visitor.)
strings.나 그노시스가 재로 변하는 순간, 알게 됩니다. 그에 앞서 그들의 의지가: You will know when I, Gnosis, become ash. First, I shall cleanse this space, where their wills linger, with fire.
strings.(그노시스의 말 한마디와 함께 불꽃이 주위에 있는 걸 조금씩 태우기 시작: (At Gnosis's words, the flames begin consuming everything around them. Everything except %s.)
strings.나 그노시스는 죽지 않습니다. 다만, 이 순간에는 사라질 뿐입니다. 다른: I, Gnosis, do not die. I merely disappear from this moment. When another moment of destruction comes, I shall awaken and return.
strings.얼마 전에도 이 별에 왔지만, 닿지 않았습니다. 그때도 당신이 파멸의 순: I came to this star recently, but could not reach it. You pushed back the moment of destruction then as well.
I might have appeared as a space called Purgatory.
strings.그래, 이것조차 그 노인이 바라는 것이겠지?: Of course. This is what that old man wants, too, isn't it?
strings.당신이 이 공간에서 벗어났다고 해서 끝이 아닙니다. 별이 지닌 파멸의 운: Escaping this space is not the end. Your star's fate of destruction endures forever, trapped in the endless cycle he created.
Even after I, Gnosis, depart, the force of destruction will remain and awaken.
strings.인간 스스로 결핍의 감정을 모두 모아 만든 멸망의 세계, 플레로마. 그: Pleroma, a world of ruin formed from all the emptiness humans gathered within themselves. And the demon god Demiurgos, sleeping inside it.
A demon god who denies all living things.
I understand. I'll have to face it, then.
strings.역시 여기 있는 당신은 특이합니다. 다른 시간에 만났던 당신은 파멸의 순: This version of you is indeed unusual. The you I met in another time screamed at the sight of destruction...
A pity. I shall have to wait to see that side of you. Farewell.
strings.(그 말과 함께 주위에 있던 불꽃이 점점 커져 파도처럼 요동친다.): (The surrounding flames swell and surge like waves.)
strings.(잠시 후, 그 파도는 방문자가 어떤 판단도 할 수 없을 정도로 높이 솟: (Before the visitor can react, they rise impossibly high and engulf everything.)
strings.(커다란 뭔가가 떨어지는 소리가 들리지만, %s의 눈에는 아무것도 보이지: (Something enormous seems to fall with a crash, but %s can see nothing.)
strings.(손을 뻗어 주위를 살펴보지만, 역시 마찬가지로 아무것도 느껴지지 않는다: (An outstretched hand searches the surroundings, finding nothing to feel.)
strings.(그런 그때, 멀리서 어디서 본 것 같은 누군가의 모습이 천천히 다가온다: (A familiar-looking figure slowly approaches from the distance.)
I have to leave. I have to get out...
strings.(한 소녀가 우산을 들고 이리저리 뛰어다니고 있다.): (A girl runs here and there, carrying an umbrella.)
strings.(저 아이는 내가 글래스턴에 오기 전에 봤던 위대한 벽 사이의 기억 속…: (That child... From the memory between the Great Wall, before I came to Glaston...)
strings.누구? 어디 있어? 어디서 날 부르는 거야?: Who? Where are you? Who's calling me?
strings.거기 있으면 내가 못 찾아낼 줄 알았어? 거기서 뭐해?: Did you think I wouldn't find you there? What are you doing?
strings.(아탈란테가 정확히 %s 앞에 서서 눈을 마주친다. 그리고 의미를 알 수: (Atalante stands directly before %s and meets their gaze with an inscrutable smile.)
strings.나 여기선 네가 보이지 않지만, 느낄 수 있어. 너는 분명 날 찾아올 거: I can't see you from here, but I can feel you. You'll come find me, won't you? You'll let me out?
The boundary is broken. Pleroma is open. So get me out of here.
strings.(아탈란테가 뭔가 느낀 건지 두 손으로 입을 막고 소스라치게 놀란다.): (Atalante suddenly covers her mouth with both hands, horrified.)
No, that wasn't me. That's not me. I don't say things like that. I... I just want to see Mommy.
strings.그러니까, 그러니까 날 찾아서 꺼내줘. 다른 건 하지 않을 거야. 나는,: So... So find me and let me out. I won't do anything else. I... I...
strings.(아탈란테의 비명과 함께 %s의 시야를 가리는 어둠이 사라진다. 어둠 속: (At Atalante's scream, the darkness blocking %s's sight vanishes. Her figure within it scatters and disappears, too.)
Atalante's gone... She seemed so unstable...
strings.(그노시스가 사라진 결핍의 경계 안 풍경은 시간의 흐름 속에서 벗어난 듯: (With Gnosis gone, the Boundary of the Void stands motionless, as though removed from the flow of time.)
strings.그노시스가 사라졌어도 그대로라니…. 여기서 어떻게 나가지?: It's still here, even with Gnosis gone... How do I leave?
strings.(언제부터 있었는지 알 수 없는 작은 빛이 %s의 주위에서 일렁인다.): (A small light of unknown origin shimmers around %s.)
strings.(뭔가에 홀린 것처럼 발걸음이 빛을 따라 옮겨가면서 일그러진 도시의 풍경: (Almost entranced, the adventurer follows it. The distorted city gradually dissolves.)
strings.(갑자기 들려오는 파르밀라의 목소리에 모험가가 놀라 주위를 둘러본다.): (Parmila's sudden voice startles the adventurer into looking around.)
Shh, be quiet. You'll bring those things down on us.
strings.(파르밀라의 뒤로 조금 전에 들어갔었던 폐가의 모습이 들어온다.): (Behind Parmila stands the abandoned house they entered earlier.)
Yes. But I don't see Callone...
The moment we entered, the darkness seized us and pulled us into separate rooms.
strings.우리가 서 있는 글래스턴이 그대로 하늘에도 있는데, 뒤집어진 글래스턴으로: We saw Glaston above us, just like the one beneath our feet. Everything was being drawn up into the inverted city. A world like that...
strings.같은 걸 봤단 말이야. 이걸 환영? 환상? 어떻게 이야기해야 할지 모르겠: We all saw the same thing. A vision? An illusion? I don't know what to call it...
strings.%s 님이 어떤 괴물과 싸우다 죽어가는 모습을 봤어요. 어떻게든 같이 싸: I saw you fighting a monster and dying, %s. I tried to fight beside you, but I... I was helpless...
strings.(모험가가 조용히 떨고 있는 리코타의 손을 붙잡는다.): (The adventurer quietly takes Licota's trembling hand.)
strings.괴물의 손에서 모두가 죽어가고 세계가 불타면서 어둠이 찾아왔어. 그렇게: Everyone was dying at the monster's hands. The world burned, then darkness came and swallowed everything...
strings.이제 끝인가, 생각하던 순간에 엄청나게 환한 빛이 다가왔어. 너무 눈부셔: Just as I thought it was over, a brilliant light appeared. It was so bright I closed my eyes...
And suddenly, we were back outside the house.
I thought we'd never see you again...
strings.(파르밀라가 바라본 쪽에 칼로네가 영혼이라도 나간 것 같은 얼굴로 주저앉: (Where Parmila looks, Callone sits with a vacant expression, as though his soul has left him.)
strings.(리코타와 파르밀라에게 그노시스와 관련된 이야기를 짧게 한다. 이야기를: (I briefly explain Gnosis to Licota and Parmila. Their faces grow grim as they listen.)
strings.멸망한 세계에 있던 주민의 의지가 우리를 도운 건 좋았는데, 마법청에서: It's good that the wills of people from destroyed worlds helped us. But what the Magic Bureau has been secretly creating is right beneath us...
strings.(파르밀라가 고개를 푹 숙인 채 입술을 깨문다.): (Parmila bows her head and bites her lip.)
strings.…나는 고마운 사람을 찾고 싶었을 뿐이야. 불행한 일에서 벗어나고 싶어서: ...I only wanted to find someone I owed so much to. I only wanted to know why these terrible things were happening, so I could escape them...
Parmila, none of us is to blame.
I know. Who could I blame? The villains, of course.
%s and I will find a way to deal with this.
But the Boundary of the Void still seems to be there. What should I do... ?
strings.(리코타가 문이 열려 있는 폐가 안을 바라보지만, 아무도 없이 집기가 어: (Licota peers through the house's open door. She sees only an empty interior strewn with household clutter.)
strings.우리가 다시 폐가를 확인했을 때는 아무것도 없었는데…. %s에게는 그 공: We checked the house again, and there was nothing... But that space is still there for you, %s?
strings.나와 칼로네는 평범한 인간이라서 도움이 되지 못할 거 같아. 미안해. 원: Callone and I are ordinary humans. I don't think we can help. I'm sorry. We'll return to our own world.
strings.너무 걱정하지 마. 여기까지 잘 피해서 왔으니까 돌아가는 건 괜찮을 거야: Don't worry. We made it here safely, so we can make it back. I am the commander of the Oscuras Mercenaries, after all.
strings.(파르밀라가 자신만만한 표정으로 엄지손가락을 들어 자신을 가리킨다.): (Parmila points a thumb at herself with a confident expression.)
strings.지금 한시가 급해. 빨리 거기로 가봐. 마신인지 뭔지 깨어났다는 그 장소: There's no time to lose. Go to that place where the demon god, or whatever it is, has awakened.
All right, Parmila. Come on, Rico.
strings.(파르밀라가 밀어내듯 두 사람을 보내고 난 후, 구석에 앉아 있는 칼로네: (After practically shooing them away, Parmila looks at Callone sitting in the corner.)
Callone, snap out of it. They're gone.
strings.(칼로네가 파르밀라의 말에 평소 표정으로 돌아온다. 그리고 파르밀라의 옆: (At her words, Callone's usual expression returns. He approaches Parmila and checks their surroundings.)
I didn't think you'd be that convincing.
strings.후우, 살려고 한 것입니다. 단장이 고양이 찾겠다면서 마수의 둥지 같은: Phew. I was trying to survive. I thought back to when you pushed me into a monster's nest to look for a cat...
Your acting was terrible, but it did the job.
strings.신호를 줘서 모르는 척, 정신 나간 연기를 했습니다만, 이제 어떻게 할: You gave the signal, so I pretended to know nothing and acted dazed. What now?
Our squawking friend's information wasn't necessarily wrong.
Let's find our own way there.
%s, the barrier is gone. We should be able to enter.
strings.(리코타가 장벽 확인차 뻗었던 손을 거둔다. 그리고 맨홀 앞을 빤히 바라: (Licota lowers the hand she extended to test the barrier and approaches %s, who is staring at the manhole.)
Now that it's time to go in, I'm a little afraid. I thought I'd prepared myself...
strings.아뇨, 괜찮아요. 그럼 갈까요?: No, I'm all right. Let's go.
strings.(리코타가 조용히 고개를 끄덕이고 반쯤 닫힌 맨홀 뚜껑을 옆으로 밀어낸다: (Licota quietly nods and pushes the half-closed manhole cover aside.)
Thank you, Rico. Let's head down.
strings.(사다리를 타고 한참을 내려가는 동안, 주위가 모두 심연에 삼켜진 것처럼: (The long descent down the ladder passes through darkness so complete it seems the abyss has swallowed everything.)
(At last, solid ground replaces the precarious rungs beneath their feet. The darkness slowly lifts, revealing an unfamiliar sight.)
strings.그노시스라고 했던 괴물이 부른 장소가 맞는 것 같아요. 그런데, 그 여자: It seems to be the place that creature Gnosis named. But that little girl...
strings.(마신이 깨어난 장소를 헤매고 있는 아이….): (A child wandering where a demon god has awakened...)
strings.(리코타가 고갯짓으로 멀리 서 있는 누군가를 가리킨다. 그리고 랜스를 들: (Licota indicates a distant figure with a nod. As she raises her lance, it appears before them in the blink of an eye.)
strings.(리코타가 서둘러 랜스를 휘두르지만, 그 존재는 아무렇지도 않은 듯 뒤로: (Licota hastily swings her lance, but the figure steps lightly back, untroubled.)
strings.제군들, 환영하네. 부르지 않아도 스스로 마신께서 계신 플레로마에 찾아오: Welcome, my friends. You have come unbidden to Pleroma, abode of the demon god.
The divine one will be pleased. How long it has been since I witnessed that sacred power...
strings.(노란색 정장을 입은 남자가 희열에 가득 찬 표정으로 중얼거린다.): (A man in a yellow suit murmurs in ecstasy.)
strings.(남자가 %s의 질문에 콧수염을 만지작거리며 조소를 보인다.): (At %s's question, he toys with his mustache and sneers.)
strings.인간이었을 때의 이름이 기억나질 않는군. 지금은 새로운 신이 될 분의 힘: I no longer recall the name I bore as a human. Now I follow the power and authority of the one who shall become a new god...
strings.일단은 날 미스터 데모닉이라고 부르게. 나약한 인간들이 부르던 살인귀 젠: Call me Mr. Demonic for now. Weak humans once called me the murderer Gentleman, I believe. But I never cared for that name.
The killer who murdered Glaston's citizens every night, decades ago...
strings.(리코타와 %s의 경계 자세를 보던 미스터 데모닉이 고개를 끄덕인다.): (Seeing Licota and %s take defensive stances, Mr. Demonic nods.)
strings.날 잘 알고 있군. 칭찬해 주겠네. 그렇다고 해서 그냥 돌아가게 두지는: You know me well. Commendable. That doesn't mean I'll let you leave.
strings.이곳에 내려온 순간부터 제군들은 그분을 위한 제물이지. 그동안 내가 바친: From the moment you came down here, you became offerings to the divine one. How many sacrifices have I made already? I can scarcely remember.
strings.사람을 죽인 이유가 마신을 위해?: You killed those people for the demon god?
strings.이제 얼마 남지 않았다. 그분이 제대로 깨어나 세계를 삼킬 그날이!!: The day is almost here! The day the divine one fully awakens and devours the world!
We'll have to take him down first.
Hehe. You think you can defeat me... Wait. You are...
strings.(미스터 데모닉이 살며시 웃으며 그림자 속에 손을 집어넣는다. 잠시 후,: (Smiling faintly, Mr. Demonic reaches into the shadows. He draws out a huge pair of sharp scissors, which separates into two blades in his hands.)
strings.제군이 어떤 연유로 그런 복을 얻었는지 모르겠지만…. 참으로 부럽고도 화: I don't know how you obtained such a blessing... But I am both envious and furious. How I wish to pierce your heart myself...
Yet the divine one wishes to see you, so I shall refrain for now.
strings.(미스터 데모닉이 들고 있던 가위를 거두고 등을 돌린다.): (Mr. Demonic puts away his scissors and turns.)
strings.그분을 만나러 가는 길이 쉽지 않을 걸세. 그 길 위에 나도 있다는 거: The road to the divine one will not be easy. Remember that I, too, stand upon it. Best of luck.
strings.(그 말과 함께 미스터 데모닉이 자리에서 모습을 감춘다. 서둘러 쫓아가려: (With that, Mr. Demonic vanishes. They hurry to pursue, but someone running toward them makes them stop.)
strings.(우산을 든 아탈란테가 리코타와 %s의 옆으로 스쳐 지나간다.): (Umbrella in hand, Atalante runs past Licota and %s.)
You came, %s. But where are you? I can hear your voice.
Wait. I never told you my name...
strings.(그 순간, 아탈란테가 %s의 눈과 마주치자 의미를 알 수 없는 미소를: (Atalante meets %s's eyes and gives an inscrutable smile.)
strings.(그러고는 아무렇지도 않은 듯 어디론가 사라진다. 뭔가 수상함을 느낀 리: (Then she disappears as though nothing has happened. Sensing something wrong, Licota pursues her, only to be forced back by an unknown power.)
strings.자신을 쫓는 걸 허락하지 않는다는 건가?: She won't let us follow her?
You knew that girl, didn't you? Please tell me who she is.
strings.%s 님, 지금 우리가 자의로 이곳에 왔다고 생각하지만, 사실 타의가 개: %s, we think we came here of our own will. But someone else's will may be involved.
strings.그 괴물이 말했듯이 이 세계의 파멸을 바라는 자가 개입했겠지만, 직접적으: As that monster said, the one who desires this world's destruction must be involved. But they wouldn't act directly.
So if a demon god has awakened to act in their place... Oh, no...
Learning your name would have been easy, %s.
I was hoping that wasn't it...
strings.%s 님께서 하실 말씀이 뭔지 알아요. 하지만, 저는 뒤틀린 어둠을 걷는: I know what you're going to say, %s. But I am a knight who walks the twisted darkness. I came here to fulfill my duty.
Our paths merely happen to coincide for a while, %s.
strings.(리코타가 %s의 앞으로 걸어가려다 잠시 발걸음을 멈춘다.): (Licota starts to walk ahead of %s, then stops.)
strings.플레로마에서 깨어난 존재는 저보단 %s 님이 먼저 오길 기다리는 것 같아: The being awakened in Pleroma seems to be waiting for you to lead, %s. It's blocking my steps...
No, I'm sorry. I was hasty.
strings.(리코타가 %s의 뒤로 물러나자, 멀리서 조금 전까지 느껴지지 않던 바람: (When Licota steps behind %s, a breeze begins to blow from the distance, carrying an unfamiliar scent.)
strings.마법서가 마력으로 증발하거나 타오를 때 이런 냄새가 나요. 웬만해서는 느: Spellbooks smell like that when magic burns or vaporizes them. Usually it's too faint to notice...
How much magic did they use...? Phew.
We need to hurry, Rico. I'm counting on you.
I can't believe a place like this exists beneath Glaston...
strings.(지하수로 끝에 보이는 낯선 장소는 화려한 글래스턴과는 전혀 다른 모습으: (The strange place at the end of the waterway is nothing like the splendid city above.)
I'd believe it if someone called this a cave.
strings.(동굴처럼 생긴 길 위로 커다란 기둥이 세워져 있고, 그 옆에 마력으로: (Great pillars line the cavernous path, with crystals formed of magic tied or suspended beside them.)
strings.마력이 담겨 있어서 마석이라고 할 수도 있겠지만, 초인 바이스가 사용했던: They hold magic, so you could call them magic stones. But they're clearly different from the ones the demigod Weiss used.
They don't seem to have been made from living beings...
strings.(두 사람이 주위를 살펴보던 중, 다른 쪽에서 이곳을 응시하고 있던 누군: (As they examine their surroundings, they meet the eyes of someone watching from the other side.)
strings.오랫동안 기다렸어. 날 꺼내주려고 온 거 맞지? 응?: I've waited so long. You came to let me out, right? Right?
Me? Atalante... Who else would I be... ?
strings.그러니까 나는, 나는 누구지?: I mean... I... Who am I?
strings.몰라. 깨어나 보니 여기 있었어. 여기는 마법사들이 큰일을 한다고 준비한: I don't know. I woke up here. The mages prepared this place for something important. They said they'd let me out when the time came...
But they just said it failed and left me here. They're horrible men.
strings.이름도 없는 그 아이가 밖으로 나갔을 때, 나도 같이 나갔어야 했는데,: When that nameless child went outside, I should have gone, too. But I listened to the men. And now look...
You got in here, %s, so take me out. Please...
strings.이름 없는 아이? 잠깐, 노네임?: A nameless child? Wait, No Name?
strings.노네임을 아는구나. 어떻게 알고 있는 거야? 내가 맞춰볼게!: You know No Name? How do you know him? Let me guess!
strings.노네임이 신의 힘을 얻고 싶어서 오르카리움인가 뭔가 하는 곳에 갔었지?: He went to Orcarium, or whatever it's called, to get a god's power, right? You met him there? Then I think he went with a demon called the Grand Duke...
strings.너 그걸 어떻게 알고 있어?: How do you know all that?
strings.몰라. 나는 그냥 알 수 있었어. %s, 나, 날 꺼내줘. 구해달라고 하: I don't know. I just knew. %s, let me out. I won't ask you to save me. If you just let me leave...
strings.(아탈란테가 자신이 입 밖으로 내뱉은 말에 놀란다. 그 말에 두 사람이: (Atalante looks shocked by her own words. When the pair tense, she waves her hands in denial.)
strings.…아, 아냐. 이, 이건 내가 아냐…. 내 진심이 아니라고. 미안해, 내: ...N-no. That wasn't me... I didn't mean it. I'm sorry. I was wrong.
strings.아탈란테…, 그래서 넌 내가 어떻게 했으면 좋겠어?: Atalante... What do you want me to do?
strings.(아탈란테가 불안해하며 주위를 두리번거린다. 그러다가 멀리서 다가오는 누: (Atalante looks around anxiously, then recoils at the sight of someone approaching.)
I thought we'd put him down for good...
strings.이 쥐새끼들, 감히 날 욕보이다니…. 여기서 그분을 만나기 전에 내가 먼: You rats. How dare you humiliate me... Before you meet the divine one, I'll tear you—
strings.(미스터 데모닉이 돌기둥 뒤에 숨어 불안해하는 아탈란테를 발견하고는 살짝: (Mr. Demonic spots Atalante hiding anxiously behind a stone pillar and smiles.)
strings.아저씨는 왜 날 그렇게 부르는 거죠?: Why do you call me that, mister?
You shall awaken as a demon god and become ruler of the new world.
strings.마법사들이 당신을 실패라고 했지만, 저는 믿어 의심치 않습니다. 그렇기에: The mages called you a failure, but I have never doubted you. That is why I offered you the power of life.
strings.크롤리가 보여준 미래가 여기 있으니까요. 후후. 오래 걸렸습니다. 대체: The future Crowley showed me is here. Hehe. It has taken so long. How many years has it been... ?
strings.당신께서 가끔 깨어나 마법사들을 심판하셨을 때, 전율이 흘렀습니다. 아름: Whenever you briefly awakened to judge the mages, I trembled with awe. Judge this beautiful, hideous world...
strings.이제 당신 앞에 있는 저와 신의 가호를 받은 자를 죽여 그대로 거두신다면: Kill me and this god-blessed one before you, and claim us! Then you will be complete. Once you leave Pleroma...
(Watching Mr. Demonic's ecstasy, Atalante quietly steps forward.)
strings.(아탈란테의 손에 있던 우산이 날카로운 소리와 함께 그대로 미스터 데모닉: (With a sharp sound, the umbrella in Atalante's hand pierces Mr. Demonic's heart.)
Nngh... As he desires, this star shall reach its end...
strings.(미스터 데모닉이 가슴을 움켜쥔 채로 고통을 호소하지만, 얼굴엔 미소가: (Mr. Demonic clutches his chest in pain, but his face remains full of joy.)
strings.(잠시 후, 그의 모습이 일그러지더니 굉음과 함께 먼지로 변한다. 그리고: (His figure distorts, then turns to dust with a thunderous sound. It scatters through Pleroma and vanishes.)
Pull yourself together, %s. Something's wrong with Atalante.
strings.(미스터 데모닉의 소원을 들어준 아탈란테가 갑자기 털썩 주저앉아 소리를: (Having fulfilled Mr. Demonic's wish, Atalante suddenly collapses and screams.)
strings.이건 내가 한 게 아니야. 내가 원해서 하는 게 아니야. 나는, 나는 살: I didn't do that. I didn't want to do it. I... I just wanted to live...
