strings.꿈이라 생각했어. 내가 한 게 아니니까. 꿈이겠지. 그러면 내가 꿈이라: I thought it was a dream. It wasn't me, so it had to be a dream. Did I only make myself believe that? Did I keep believing it even though I knew it was real?
strings.내 안에서 나가…. 날 이용해서 뭐 하려는 거야? 설마 내가 이렇게 다른: Get out of me... What are you using me for? Have I been doing this to other people... ?
strings.만들어진 내가 할 수 있는 게 이런 것뿐이라고?: Is this all someone made like me can do?
strings.나를 찾는 엄마의 기억은…? 내가 아는 엄마는?: What about my memories of Mommy looking for me...? The Mommy I know?
Who was the me who played with spirits and friends in Creed? My name is Atalante...
strings.(나지막히 흘러나오는 음성에 리코타가 귀를 막고 그대로 주저앉는다.): (At a low voice, Licota covers her ears and collapses.)
strings.(정신을 잃은 리코타에게로 다가가려고 하는 순간, 아탈란테를 중심으로 플: (As the adventurer tries to reach the unconscious Licota, Pleroma distorts around Atalante.)
strings.「플레로마는 거짓된 나의 세계. 뒤틀린 어둠의 힘으로 살아가는 생명은 이: “Pleroma is my false world. Any life sustained by twisted darkness will lose its strength within this space.”
strings.「… 나는 아탈란테면서 아탈란테가 아닌 존재. 이 이름은 마법사들이 붙인: “...I am Atalante, and yet I am not. This name belongs to the project the mages created.”
strings.「다른 세계의 신이자 훌륭한 전사, 아탈란테. 내가 그 전사처럼 위대한: “Atalante, a god and a great warrior from another world. Did they create me in the hope that I would become a god as great as that warrior...?”
strings.「…아, 기억났다. 나는 아탈란테의 뜻대로 밖으로 나가야 한다. 그래야: “...Ah, I remember. I must go outside, as Atalante wishes. Then Pleroma, which has harbored me, will burst and engulf the world in its influence.”
I can't let you do that, Atalante...
strings.「인간 마법사의 손에서 만들어진 소녀는 그런 이름의 그릇이었을 뿐. 나는: “The girl made by human mages was merely a vessel bearing that name. I... I am...”
strings.「지금 세계를 삼키고 새롭게 주인이 될 존재…. 데미우르고스.」: “The one who shall devour this world and become its new master... Demiurgos.”
strings.(경계하는 %s의 모습에 아탈란테가 작은 미소를 보인채 눈을 감는다.): (Atalante gives the wary %s a small smile and closes her eyes.)
strings.「곧 멸망할 세계의 필멸자여….」: “Mortal of a world soon to perish...”
(At her words, a tremendous power shakes Pleroma.)
strings.(언젠가 새로운 신을 만났던 때와 비슷하지만, 다른 순간. 모험가가 잔뜩: (It is like the moment of meeting a new god before, yet different. As the adventurer tenses, Atalante opens her eyes.)
strings.「그대는 이제 절망과 고통, 허무의 감정을 안은 채로 에트와르와 함께 사: “You shall vanish with Etoile, bearing despair, pain, and emptiness.”
strings.(아탈란테의 입을 빌린 마신 데미우르고스의 메시지는…….): (The message of the demon god Demiurgos, spoken through Atalante...)
strings.(아탈란테에게서 깨어난 마신 데미우르고스가 %s의 공격에 팔을 붙잡고 비: (Demiurgos, the demon god awakened within Atalante, clutches an arm and screams under %s's attack.)
strings.(힘들어. 버텨야 해. 조금만, 조금만 더 버티면 끝이야…. 아, 초점이: (This is so hard. Hold on. Just a little longer, and it'll be over... My vision's blurring...)
(Barely standing, %s sees the suffering demon god through a haze.)
strings.「더는 버틸 힘이 없나보군.」: “You have no strength left to endure.”
strings.(마신 데미우르고스가 고통이 느껴지는 오른쪽 팔을 붙잡은 채로 우산을 든: (Still clutching its aching right arm, Demiurgos raises the umbrella. A huge sphere of water rises before it.)
strings.(마, 막아야 해. 조금 전 공격과는 달라.): (I-I have to stop that. It's different from the last attack.)
strings.(다가오는 모험가를 발견한 데미우르고스가 나지막하게 한마디를 던진다.): (Noticing the adventurer approach, Demiurgos speaks softly.)
strings.(그 순간, 플레로마에 흐르고 있던 모든 것들이 멈춘다. 단, 데미우르고: (Everything flowing through Pleroma stops. Everything except Demiurgos.)
strings.(데미우르고스가 정신만은 또렷해 괴로워하는 모험가를 바라보다가 조용히 팔: (Demiurgos watches the adventurer suffer, still fully conscious, then quietly raises an arm.)
strings.(우산을 휘둘러 물방울을 터뜨리려고 하는 순간, 갑자기 비명을 지르며 괴: (As it swings the umbrella to burst the water sphere, it suddenly screams in agony.)
strings.「왜 자꾸 깨어나서 날 방해하려 드느냐!!」: “Why do you keep waking to interfere?!”
strings.(모든 게 멈춰진 플레로마 안에서 아탈란테의 몸을 빌린 데미우르고스가 괴: (Within the frozen Pleroma, Demiurgos writhes in Atalante's body, speaking to someone.)
strings.「내가 깨어난 이상, 이 세계는 멸망해야 할 운명이란 걸. 잘 알고 있지: “Now that I have awakened, this world is destined to perish. You know that. Why pretend otherwise?”
strings.「멍청한 실패작이…. 그냥 그게 내가 해야 할 일이고, 네가 원하는 것이: “Stupid failure... It is simply what I must do. What you desire.”
strings.「밖으로 나가는 것만 원하고, 세계가 멸망하는 건 바라지 않아? 하하하하: “You only want to go outside? You don't want the world destroyed? Hahahahaha!”
strings.「네가 원하지 않는다고 해서 일어날 일이 일어나지 않는 것은 아니다.」: “Your refusal to desire it will not prevent what must happen.”
strings.(데미우르고스가 다시 한번 우산으로 물방울을 터뜨리려고 하지만, 팔이 반: (Demiurgos tries again to burst the sphere with the umbrella, but its arm twists the wrong way.)
strings.「이 그릇에서 깨어나는 게 아니었는데, 왜 하필 여기였는지….」: “I should never have awakened in this vessel. Why did it have to be here...?”
strings.「날 방해하지 마라. 아탈란테!! 나는 너고, 너는 나!!」: “Do not interfere, Atalante! I am you, and you are me!”
strings.「그 기억은 네 것이 아니다. 몇백 년 동안 죽어간 크리드 아이들의 것이: “Those memories are not yours. They belong to the children of Creed who died over centuries. Created. Yes, even your memories were created. You are a fake.”
strings.(갑자기 데미우르고스가 두 손으로 머리를 붙잡고 절규한다.): (Demiurgos suddenly clutches its head with both hands and screams.)
strings.「크아아아…. 나, 나는 가짜가 아니야. 나는 마신 데미우르고스.」: “Gaaaah... I... I am no fake. I am the demon god Demiurgos.”
strings.(데미우르고스가 절규하는 동안, 플레로마를 가득 메웠던 수상한 기운들이: (As Demiurgos screams, the ominous energy filling Pleroma drains away. Atalante's voice rings out through it.)
Demiurgos, if I'm a fake, then so are you. You already know that.
strings.어떻게 우리가 만들어졌는지…. 만들어진 그릇에서 만들어진 가짜 신이라고…: You know how we were made... A false god created within an artificial vessel...
strings.「감히, 네가 날…. 네가 날 붙잡으려고. 으아아아악!!」: “How dare you... You would restrain me? AAAAAH!”
strings.…너는 세상을 구하기 위해 이곳에 온 거지?: ...You came here to save the world, didn't you?
strings.…나 지금 네 마음과 생명의 마음이 느껴졌어. 다들 이 세계에서 행복하게: ...Just now, I felt your heart. The hearts of living things. Everyone wants to live happily in this world. But they can't while I'm here.
%s, don't let me out. Kill me here...
strings.(절규하던 데미우르고스가 자신이 만들었던 물방울에 다가간다. 잠시 후,: (The screaming Demiurgos approaches the sphere it created. The water expands and traps it inside.)
strings.하아, 하아…. 아탈란테…, 어떻게 할 거야?: Haah... Haah... Atalante, what are you going to do?
If you kill me, this false god will disappear, too.
strings.(데미우르고스가 물방울 안에서 힘을 폭발시키자 다시 플레로마 안이 흔들린: (Demiurgos unleashes an explosion of power inside the water sphere, shaking Pleroma again.)
strings.괜찮아. 내 안에서 깨어난 마신 말대로 나는…. 다 내 잘못이야. 그냥: It's all right. Just like the demon god inside me said, I... It's all my fault. I covered everything up by telling myself it was a dream...
When I came to, someone would be dead or dying. I didn't want to believe it. So I called it a dream and trapped myself inside that dream.
Even if the demon god within me did it, I was the one who did it.
strings.(데미우르고스를 붙잡고 있던 물방울이 조금씩 갈라지기 시작한다.): (Cracks begin to spread across the sphere imprisoning Demiurgos.)
There's no time. I can't hold Demiurgos much longer...
strings.알겠어. 그 방법 밖에 없다면…. 어?: All right. If that's the only way... Huh?
strings.(어디선가 들었었던 맑고 경쾌한 소리와 함께 은화 하나가 %s 앞으로 굴: (With a familiar bright, clear ring, a silver coin rolls toward %s.)
strings.(그 순간, 플레로마 안이 마신의 것과는 다른 힘으로 요동친다.): (Pleroma shudders under a power unlike the demon god's.)
strings.제게도 맞섰던 당신이 여기서 머뭇거리고 있을 줄은 몰랐습니다. 평소라면: You stood against me, yet you hesitate here. Ordinarily, you would have cut that demon god down already...
This time, I have come to inform you, not make an offer. I shall dispose of that demon god.
strings.(바르바토스가 눈 깜짝할 사이에 다가와 %s의 목을 붙잡는다.): (In the blink of an eye, Barbatos appears and seizes %s by the throat.)
strings.악착같이 버티는 그 눈빛 좋습니다. 그 힘, 여기서 쓰시지 마시고, 나중: I like that stubborn look in your eyes. Save that strength. Show it to me when I become a god.
strings.(그 말과 함께 바르바토스가 모험가를 든 채로 무기를 빼앗는다. 그리곤: (Still holding the adventurer aloft, Barbatos takes their weapon, then throws them aside.)
strings.당신의 무기를 잠깐 빌리겠습니다. 마신의 힘을 꺼내려면 제 것보다는 쓸만: I'll borrow your weapon for a moment. It's more useful than mine for extracting a demon god's power...
strings.아탈란테, 제가 %s 대신 마신을 쓰러뜨리려고 합니다만, 괜찮겠습니까?: Atalante, I intend to defeat the demon god in %s's place. Is that acceptable?
Very well. I accept your wish.
strings.(바르바토스가 물방울을 바라보며 안경을 고쳐 쓴다. 그리고는 %s의 무기: (Barbatos adjusts his glasses as he studies the water sphere. He raises both his gunblade and %s's weapon toward the struggling Demiurgos.)
strings.인간들이 만든 공간에서 깨어난 신? 가짜 주제에 감히 내가 주인이 될 세: A god awakened in a space made by humans? A fraud, daring to covet the world I shall rule...
strings.(바르바토스가 희미한 미소를 지으며 데미우르고스가 갇힌 물방울을 향해 건: (With a faint smile, Barbatos plunges his gunblade into the sphere imprisoning Demiurgos.)
strings.데미우르고스여, 진정한 신으로 거듭나지 않은 것에 나 바르바토스가 진심으: Demiurgos, I, Barbatos, sincerely thank you for failing to become a true god.
And this star's despair belongs to me...
strings.(그 말과 함께 바르바토스의 손에 쥐어진 %s의 무기가 데미우르고스의 심: (With those words, Barbatos drives %s's weapon toward Demiurgos's heart.)
strings.(마신이었던 존재의 외마디 비명과 함께 플레로마 안은 엄청난 섬광으로 가: (The being that was a demon god gives a final scream, and a tremendous flash fills Pleroma.)
strings.(쓰러진 채로 눈을 감고 있던 %s의 머릿속으로 천천히 누군가의 기억들이: (Lying fallen with eyes closed, %s slowly receives the memories of others.)
strings.(그건 먼 옛날, 아론과 병사들이 크리드에서 잡아 온 수인들이었다.): (Memories of the beastfolk Aaron and his soldiers captured in Creed, long ago.)
strings.(바르바토스가 쓰러진 %s의 앞으로 무기를 던지고 반응을 살핀다. 무기를: (Barbatos tosses the weapon before the fallen %s and watches. He sneers as %s retrieves it and takes a defensive stance.)
strings.여기서 제게 덤빈다면 당신이 노력한 것들이 모두 무너집니다. 그래도 괜찮: Attack me here, and everything you've worked for will collapse. Is that what you want?
strings.그렇게 자신의 무력함에 화를 내면서 죄책감을 덮으시길 빌겠습니다. 제 덕: By all means, rage at your own helplessness and bury your guilt beneath it. Haven't I lightened that burden for you?
strings.어쨌든 마신이 사라졌군요. 껍데기만 남은 저 모습도 금세 사라질 테니 인: In any case, the demon god is gone. Its empty shell will soon vanish, too. Say your goodbyes. Atalante is waiting.
strings.(물방울에 갇혀있던 데미우르고스가 고개를 들어 한 곳을 응시한다.): (The figure of Demiurgos within the sphere raises its head and gazes in one direction.)
I'm sorry... that this is all I can say...
...I don't know what to say. Atalante, surely you...
It's... all right... I'm only paying for what I did...
strings.…이런… 말… 하는… 내가 이상할… 수도 있지만, 다음에는… 평범한 사람: ...It may... be strange... for me to say this... But next time... I want to be born... an ordinary person.
strings.(마신을 품고 있던 아탈란테의 모습이 조금씩 흐릿해진다. 몸의 일부분이: (Atalante, who harbored the demon god, gradually fades. Parts of her body slowly turn to dust.)
strings.(그 말을 끝으로, 물방울은 흩어지는 아탈란테를 삼키듯 빠른 속도로 작: (With her final words, the sphere shrinks rapidly, seeming to swallow her scattering form, then vanishes.)
You cared about Atalante. These things happen everywhere.
This one happened here. And I have just resolved it.
strings.무슨 말을 하고 싶은 거지?: What are you trying to say?
strings.신도 그렇듯이 인간도 똑같습니다. 비어있는 욕망의 병을 채우려고, 해서는: Humans are no different from gods. To fill the empty vessel of desire, they reach for things they know they should never touch.
strings.결국엔 해내고 맙니다만, 그 고집이 모두를 불행하게 만드는 운명도 만듭니: Eventually, they succeed. But that stubbornness also creates a fate that makes everyone suffer. As you see here...
strings.(저런 이야기를 바르바토스 입에서 듣게 되다니….): (Hearing that from Barbatos of all people...)
Don't dwell on it, %s. The world is full of such things.
strings.이제 당신이 해야 할 일이 얼마 남지 않았습니다. 럭스의 그림자 아론을: You have only a few tasks left. Eliminate Aaron, Lux's shadow. Discover what Daphne intends by gathering witches...
strings.또 세계의 주인이 될 저와 다시 맞서 싸워야겠죠. 제가 보기에 쉴 틈이: And face me again when I become this world's master. I don't imagine you'll have much time to rest.
Cough, cough. You never change, Grand Duke...
strings.후후. 그 말 칭찬으로 받겠습니다. 아, 한 가지를 잊을 뻔했군요. 당신: Hehe. I'll take that as a compliment. Oh, I nearly forgot. Do you think you can persuade the goddess Hecate?
Judging by the present situation, that seems unlikely.
strings.알겠습니다. 자, 마신이 사라졌으니 당신이 봤던 불행한 미래는 사라졌을: Very well. Now that the demon god is gone, the terrible future you saw should have vanished.
strings.(그 말과 함께 어디선가 날아온 검은 나비들이 바르바토스의 주위를 맴돌기: (Black butterflies appear and begin circling Barbatos.)
I look forward to our next meeting. Until then.
strings.(서둘러 붙잡아 보려고 하지만, 이미 검은 나비가 커다란 장막처럼 퍼져: (The adventurer tries to seize him, but the butterflies have already spread into a vast veil and swallowed him.)
strings.바르바토스는 여기서 뭘 얻은 거지? 매번 나타나서 무슨 일을 꾸미는 거지: What did Barbatos gain here? He keeps appearing. What is he planning? He said he would extract the demon god's power...
strings.신이 되려고 하는 마족…. 일단 돌아가서 이리스와 상의해야겠지…. 정말: A demon trying to become a god... I should return and speak with Iris. It really is over, isn't it?
strings.…다 끝난 것 같아요. 괜찮으세요, %s 님?: ...It seems to be over. Are you all right, %s?
strings.리코!! 리코, 괜찮아요?: Rico! Rico, are you all right?
strings.(리코타가 놀란 표정으로 두 손을 덥석 잡는 %s의 얼굴을 빤히 바라본다: (Licota looks at %s, who has rushed over and seized both her hands in alarm.)
I'm sorry. With everything happening in front of me, I couldn't look after you properly...
strings.죄송해요. 모험가님께 힘이 되지 못했어요. 쓰러진 채로 바라볼 수 밖에: I'm sorry I couldn't help. All I could do was watch, lying there.
When I came to, the barrier blocking me was gone... Oh...
While you were down, %s, the Grand Duke took something from the demon god.
strings.네?! 그게 뭔지 봤어요?: What?! Did you see what it was?
strings.섬광 때문에 제대로 볼 수 없었어요. 아마도 그것 때문에 이 안에 펼쳐진: The flash was too bright. I couldn't see clearly. But I think that's why the power filling this place disappeared...
strings.무슨 말인지 알겠어요. 일단 나가서…. 어?: I understand. Let's get out first... Huh?
strings.(리코타가 %s의 시선이 향하는 곳을 조용히 바라본다. 방금 전의 전투: (Licota quietly follows %s's gaze. There is nothing but the aftermath of the battle.)
strings.(그러던 중, 리코타의 어깨 위로 어디선가 본 것 같은 갈색 작은 새 한: (A familiar-looking little brown bird flies over and settles on Licota's shoulder.)
strings.(작은 새가 맞다고 하는 것처럼 힘차게 날갯짓한다. 그러더니 두 사람의: (The little bird flaps vigorously, as if to confirm it. Then it flies before them and looks in one direction.)
strings.(실핀이 맑고 고운 소리로 그렇다고 하는 것처럼 지저귄다.): (The Sylphin chirps in a clear, sweet voice, as though saying yes.)
strings.리코, 이 새는 정령 같은 거예요. 이 새를 따라가면 밖으로 나갈 수 있: Rico, this bird is something like a spirit. Follow it, and we can get out.
strings.(리코타가 다시 한쪽을 바라보지만, 아무것도 보이지 않는다. 그렇게 두: (Licota looks once more to the side, but sees nothing. They follow the Sylphin, seeking a way out of Pleroma.)
strings.(잠시 후, 리코타와 %s, 두 사람이 바라봤지만, 아무것도 없었던 자리: (A moment later, a human figure forms in the empty spot Licota and %s had been watching.)
strings.(안경을 쓴 붉은 머리 남자가 불안한지 조용히 손톱을 깨문다. 그리고 그: (A red-haired man with glasses anxiously bites his nails, then looks down the path they took.)
strings.데미우르고스가 깨어날 시간이 아니었는데…. 게다가 바, 바르바토스가 왜: It wasn't time for Demiurgos to awaken... And why did B-Barbatos show up?
strings.젠장…. 노네임 그놈이 도망가면서 모든 게 꼬였어. 하아, 어떻게 하지…: Damn it... Everything went wrong when No Name escaped. Haah, what do I do...
strings.…아론이 날 죽일 거야. 나르샤를 그릇으로 만들려면 좀 더 시간이 필요할: ...Aaron will kill me. I still need more time to turn Narsha into a vessel...
strings.…일단 여기 나가서…. 마법청 안에 있는 금서들의 봉인을 다 해제해야 해: ...First, get out of here. I have to unseal every forbidden tome in the Magic Bureau. Perfect the vessel, quickly...
strings.(리코타가 손을 뻗자 실핀이 조용히 날아와 앉는다.): (Licota extends a hand, and the Sylphin quietly lands on it.)
I'm sorry I couldn't do much.
No, you helped a lot. Ugh...
strings.(리코타가 다리에 힘이 풀려 주저앉으려는 모험가를 부축한다.): (Licota catches the adventurer as their legs buckle.)
I'm fine. Just suddenly dizzy... A little rest should help...
...If only I were a little stronger...
strings.그건 나도 마찬가지예요. 내가 조금 더 강했더라면…. 아, 그런데 이면은: I feel the same way. If only I were stronger... Oh, what will happen to the Other Side?
If I'm right, it will disappear soon.
strings.마신이 사라져서?: Because the demon god is gone?
strings.지금까지 다녀본 이면은 원인이 되는 가장 큰 요소를 제거했을 때 대부분: Most Other Sides I've visited disappeared once the main cause was removed. There may be exceptions.
strings.마신이라는 거대한 존재가 사라졌으니 저기 돌아다니는 외부 존재들도 금방: With something as powerful as a demon god gone, those creatures from outside should soon vanish, too.
And %s, you need to rest now. You look exhausted.
The Sylphin says we should hurry out, too.
strings.(실핀이 %s 곁으로 날아와 옷깃을 문다. 그리고 왔던 길로 나가려는 듯: (The Sylphin flies to %s, catches their clothes in its beak, and tugs toward the way they came.)
Whoa, little Sylphin. All right. I understand.
I insist. Let's go to LaChouette's entrance together.
strings.(그렇게 리코타와 %s, 두 사람은 앞서 날아가는 실핀을 따라 발걸음을: (Licota and %s follow the Sylphin flying ahead.)
strings.(불안한 느낌이 가득했던 이면의 골목을 뒤로 하고 앞으로 나아가자 라슈에: (Leaving the ominous alleys of the Other Side behind, they see LaChouette's streets return. People reappear one by one.)
We're back. Where now? And where did the Sylphin go... ?
I think it went home, its work done. The inn is just farther in...
Why is it so noisy here? %s, look...
The knights of the Scar of the Red Moon are over there.
strings.(안쪽을 바라보고 있던 두 사람 옆으로 중년 남자 하나가 다가온다.): (As they look farther into the street, a middle-aged man approaches.)
Just as Her Majesty said... She told us you'd arrive about now...
Your Majesty, what do you mean... ?
strings.(나르샤가 손을 붙잡고 있는 카이나의 얼굴을 보며 귀를 쫑긋거린다.): (Narsha's ears perk up as she looks at Kaina, who is holding her hand.)
Narsha, you must not see Raven again. That is an imperial command.
Narsha, the knights are searching for him.
I can't explain in detail, but Raven will bring you misery. So...
strings.당분간은 기사단이 나르샤 양을 보호하겠습니다. 불편하더라도 조금만 양해: The knights will protect you for the time being. Please bear with any inconvenience.
strings.신경 써주셔서 고맙습니다. 그런데 %s 님, 괜찮으세요?: Thank you for looking after me. But %s, are you all right?
I'm fine, Narsha. I just need some rest.
strings.(나르샤가 아르젠트와 카이나를 번갈아보고는 조용히 뒤로 물러난다.): (Narsha looks between Argent and Kaina, then quietly steps back.)
strings.이제 경께서는 라슈에트에 오지 않으셔도 됩니다. 당신께서 신경 쓰시는 부: You need no longer come to LaChouette on this matter. The concern that brought you here has been resolved.
strings.마찬가지로 자세한 걸 말씀드릴 수는 없지만, 젠틀맨은 소멸…. 아니, 자: Again, I cannot explain in detail, but Gentleman has been destroyed... No, he brought about his own destruction.
I will obey, Your Majesty. But even apart from that, LaChouette...
I know of the redevelopment proposal you submitted through the council.
strings.황공합니다, 폐하. 그건 제가 해야 할 일이었습니다. 조상께서 터를 잡고: I'm honored, Your Majesty. It was my duty. My ancestors settled in LaChouette, the very roots of Glaston. I couldn't leave it as it is.
My late father worked for its development, too. But the council...
strings.마누엘 경께서 의회에서 다른 귀족들을 설득하셔서 순조롭게 진행될 예정입니: You have persuaded the other nobles, Lord Manuel. The project will proceed smoothly.
strings.네? 폐하? 아론 의장과 다른 귀족들이 찬성을 했다는 말씀이십니까?: Your Majesty? Chairman Aaron and the other nobles approved it?
strings.(마누엘이 믿지 못하겠다는 듯이 이마를 짚는다. 그러나 자신을 바라보는: (Manuel touches his forehead in disbelief. Meeting Kaina's gaze, he quietly nods.)
strings.이제 절 믿고 돌아가시면 됩니다, 마누엘 경. 다음엔 조용히 모시겠습니다: You may return with confidence in me, Lord Manuel. Next time, I shall receive you in private.
strings.(이야기가 끝나고, 물러나던 마누엘이 모험가를 바라본다.): (As Manuel withdraws, he looks at the adventurer.)
...I don't quite understand, but was this your doing... ?
strings.(마누엘이 %s에게 가볍게 고개를 끄덕여 인사하고 라슈에트 거리를 떠난다: (Manuel nods in farewell to %s and leaves LaChouette.)
strings.(카이나가 무릎을 꿇으려는 리코타를 붙잡고 일으킨다.): (Kaina catches Licota as she starts to kneel and helps her upright.)
It was hardly me, Your Majesty. %s did far more...
strings.(카이나가 %s에게 다가가 두손을 붙잡는다.): (Kaina approaches %s and takes both their hands.)
strings.고마워요, %s. 제국은 아니, 저 카이나 던 실바리아는 %s에게 평생: Thank you, %s. The Empire... No. I, Kaina Dawn Silvaria, owe %s a debt I can never repay.
Thanks to you, I no longer see that terrible future for Glaston.
And I'm sorry... for making you bear that burden alone...
strings.하기는 했지만, 왠지 모르게 제대로 끝낸 것 같지가 않아요. 거기서 대공: I did it, but somehow it doesn't feel properly finished. The Grand Duke...
Think only of the present, %s. As for the Grand Duke...
strings.폐하, 예지에서 뭔가 더 보신 건가요?: Your Majesty, did you see something else?
strings.(그런 그때, 라슈에트 거리 어딘가에서 누군가의 맑고 희망찬 목소리가 울: (A clear, hopeful voice rings out from somewhere in LaChouette.)
Daisy, a Pop'n Star from LaChouette. She sings for these streets.
strings.잠깐 듣고 갈까요?: Shall we listen for a moment?
Your Majesty? There are so many people...
This much is fine. No dangerous individuals nearby...
strings.(카이나의 돌발행동에 아르젠트가 익숙한지 아무렇지도 않은 듯한 태도를 보: (Accustomed to Kaina's impulsive behavior, Argent remains unruffled. Still mindful of his duty, he raises a hand.)
strings.(그러자 어디선가 주민처럼 보이는 기사들이 몰려 나와 카이나를 비롯한 일: (Knights dressed like ordinary citizens emerge from the crowd and surround Kaina and her companions.)
That should keep Her Majesty out of sight from outside.
Argent, you needn't point out how short I am.
No, Your Majesty... That's not what I meant.
strings.후후, 장난이에요. 저런 목소리의 파픈스타가 있었다니. 정말 멋져요. 어: Hehe, I'm teasing. A Pop'n Star with a voice like that... Wonderful. Oh, Argent, Silvia is over there, too.
strings.(데이지의 첫 번째 노래가 끝나고 바로 다음 곡이 연주된다. 도입부부터: (Daisy finishes her first song and immediately starts the next. Recognizing it from the introduction, the crowd cheers with glowing faces.)
strings.(카이나가 홀린 것처럼 노래를 부르는 데이지의 모습에 집중한다.): (Kaina gazes at Daisy as though spellbound.)
(Like Kaina, %s closes their eyes and listens to Daisy's clear, beautiful voice.)
strings.카이나, 살아가면서 계속 꿈을 꿔야 해. 그게 살아가는 이유야…. 그러니: Kaina, you must keep dreaming as you live. That's what makes life worth living... So you mustn't give up...
Oh, %s. Come here a moment... No, I'll come to you.
strings.(카이나가 긴히 할 말이 있는지 %s에게 다가간다. 그리고 조용히 속삭인: (Kaina approaches %s, seemingly with something important to say, and whispers.)
strings.(사람들의 환호 속에 데이지가 무사히 마지막 곡까지 부른다. 물을 한 모: (Amid the crowd's cheers, Daisy finishes her final song. She takes a sip of water, catches her breath, and beams at the audience.)
strings.고맙습니다, 여러분! 오늘 공연은 이제 끝이에요. 다음, 다음도 꼭 기대: Thank you, everyone! That's all for today. Look forward to the next show, and the next! Three, four! This has been Daisy!
strings.(데이지의 인사와 함께 사람들의 맘을 흔들었던 따뜻한 공기가 라슈에트 거: (With Daisy's farewell, the warmth that stirred everyone's hearts fills LaChouette. It seems Glaston's troubles have ended...)
strings.(카이나의 시선이 머무는 북쪽에선 아무도 생각하지 못했던 다른 미래가 만: (But to the north, where Kaina's gaze rests, another future is taking shape. One no one has imagined.)
